name: PrimeGap186.squarefree_or_integer_interval_discrepancy_le
statement:
theorem squarefree_or_integer_interval_discrepancy_le
    (H N V : ℝ) (hH : 0 < H) (hN : 0 < N) (hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (L R : ℕ) (hR : (R : ℝ) ≤ H * N)
    (ψ : ℝ → ℂ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ)
    (hψbound : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) H,
      ‖ψ u‖ ≤ V ∧ ‖deriv ψ u‖ ≤ V)
    (squarefree : Bool)
    (q r a : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hr : 0 < r) (ha : Nat.Coprime a q) :
    let f : ℕ →₀ ℂ :=
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (max 1 L) R,
        Finsupp.single n
          (((if squarefree then |(ArithmeticFunction.moebius n : ℝ)| else 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) *
            ψ ((n : ℝ) / N))
    ‖fullDiscrepancy
        (f.filter (fun n => Nat.Coprime n r)) q a‖ ≤
      4 * (1 + H) * V * (r.divisors.card : ℝ) *
        (if squarefree then Real.sqrt (R : ℝ) else 1)

name: PrimeGap186.squarefree_primePower_correction_uniform_log_saving
statement:
theorem squarefree_primePower_correction_uniform_log_saving
    (θ : ℝ) (hθ : θ < 2 / 3) (J : ℕ) (A : ℝ) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in Filter.atTop,
      ∀ (Q : ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℕ),
        (Q : ℝ) ≤ x ^ θ → S ⊆ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊2 * x⌋₊ →
        (Real.log x) ^ A / x *
          (∑ q ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 Q).filter Squarefree,
            (q.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ J * |primePowerDiscrepancy S q (a q)|) ≤ ε

name: PrimeGap186.squarefree_prime_prod
statement:
theorem squarefree_prime_prod (S : Finset ℕ) (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, Nat.Prime p) :
    Squarefree (∏ p ∈ S, p)

name: PrimeGap186.squarefree_prod_of_squarefree_mul_prod
statement:
theorem squarefree_prod_of_squarefree_mul_prod {n : ℕ} (r : Fin n → ℕ) (s : ℕ) :
    Squarefree (s * ∏ j, r j) → Squarefree (∏ j, r j)

name: PrimeGap186.squarefree_proj_bijective
statement:
theorem squarefree_proj_bijective
    (q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (hq : Squarefree q) :
    Function.Bijective (fun t : ZMod q => (fun i : q.primeFactors => (t.val : ZMod i.1)))

name: PrimeGap186.squarefree_residue_square_roots_card_le
statement:
theorem squarefree_residue_square_roots_card_le
    (q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (hq : Squarefree q) (a : ZMod q) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun z : ZMod q => z ^ 2 = a)).card ≤ q.divisors.card

name: PrimeGap186.squarefree_subset_candidateIndices
statement:
theorem squarefree_subset_candidateIndices (N : ℕ) :
    (Finset.Ioc 0 N).filter Squarefree ⊆ squarefreeCandidateIndices N

name: PrimeGap186.squarefree_vonMangoldt_sub_prime_log_uniform_log_saving
statement:
theorem squarefree_vonMangoldt_sub_prime_log_uniform_log_saving
    (θ : ℝ) (hθ : θ < 2 / 3) (J : ℕ) (A : ℝ) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in Filter.atTop,
      ∀ (Q : ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℕ),
        (Q : ℝ) ≤ x ^ θ → S ⊆ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊2 * x⌋₊ →
        (Real.log x) ^ A / x *
          (∑ q ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 Q).filter Squarefree,
            (q.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ J *
              ‖fullDiscrepancy
                (∑ n ∈ S, Finsupp.single n
                  ((ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n -
                    (if n.Prime then Real.log (n : ℝ) else 0) : ℝ) : ℂ)) q (a q)‖) ≤ ε

name: PrimeGap186.standardFourSimplex_volume
statement:
theorem standardFourSimplex_volume :
    volume {x : Fin 4 → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i ≤ 1} =
      ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 24 : ℝ)

name: PrimeGap186.star_cosecantKernel
statement:
theorem star_cosecantKernel (x : ι → ℝ) (r s : ι) :
    star (cosecantKernel x r s) = cosecantKernel x r s

name: PrimeGap186.star_stdAddChar
statement:
theorem star_stdAddChar (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (x : ZMod p) :
    star (ZMod.stdAddChar x) = ZMod.stdAddChar (-x)

name: PrimeGap186.stdAddChar_coprime_crt
statement:
theorem stdAddChar_coprime_crt
    (m n : ℕ) [NeZero m] [NeZero n] (hmn : m.Coprime n)
    (z : ZMod (m * n)) :
    ZMod.stdAddChar z =
      ZMod.stdAddChar ((n : ZMod m)⁻¹ * (ZMod.chineseRemainder hmn z).1) *
        ZMod.stdAddChar ((m : ZMod n)⁻¹ * (ZMod.chineseRemainder hmn z).2)

name: PrimeGap186.stdAddChar_mul_cofactor
statement:
theorem stdAddChar_mul_cofactor {q p : ℕ} [NeZero q] [NeZero p]
    (hpq : p ∣ q) (k : ℕ) :
    ZMod.stdAddChar (((q / p) * k : ℕ) : ZMod q) =
      ZMod.stdAddChar (k : ZMod p)

name: PrimeGap186.stdAddChar_mul_int_add_succ
statement:
theorem stdAddChar_mul_int_add_succ {q : ℕ} [NeZero q]
    (a : ZMod q) (M : ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    ZMod.stdAddChar (a * ((M + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) : ℤ) : ZMod q)) =
      ZMod.stdAddChar (a * ((M + 1 : ℤ) : ZMod q)) *
        ZMod.stdAddChar a ^ n

name: PrimeGap186.stdAddChar_ne_one_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem stdAddChar_ne_one_of_ne_zero
    {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] {a : ZMod q} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    ZMod.stdAddChar a ≠ 1

name: PrimeGap186.stdAddChar_sum
statement:
theorem stdAddChar_sum (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (t : ZMod p) :
    (∑ x : ZMod p, ZMod.stdAddChar (t * x)) = if t = 0 then (p : ℂ) else 0

name: PrimeGap186.stdAddChar_sum_units
statement:
theorem stdAddChar_sum_units (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (t : ZMod p) :
    (∑ u : (ZMod p)ˣ, ZMod.stdAddChar (t * (u : ZMod p))) =
      if t = 0 then (p : ℂ) - 1 else -1

name: PrimeGap186.stdAddChar_sum_units_div
statement:
theorem stdAddChar_sum_units_div (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (t : ZMod p) :
    (∑ u : (ZMod p)ˣ, ZMod.stdAddChar (t / (u : ZMod p))) =
      if t = 0 then (p : ℂ) - 1 else -1

name: PrimeGap186.strict_closed_disagreement_abs_le
PrimeGap186.strict_closed_indicator_error_at_zero
statement:
theorem strict_closed_indicator_error_at_zero (a w : ℝ) :
    |(if 0 < a then w else 0) - (if 0 ≤ a then w else 0)| =
      if a = 0 then |w| else 0

name: PrimeGap186.strip_frontier_null
statement:
theorem strip_frontier_null (c : Fin 4 → ℝ) (b r : ℝ) (hc : ∃ i, c i ≠ 0) :
    (finiteMeasureWithContinuousDensity reciprocalExponentMeasure
      reciprocalResidualExponent : Measure (Fin 4 → ℝ))
      (frontier {t : Fin 4 → ℝ | |(∑ i, c i * t i) - b| ≤ r}) = 0

name: PrimeGap186.sum_Icc_divisorsAntidiagonal_fixed
statement:
theorem sum_Icc_divisorsAntidiagonal_fixed (m N p : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hp : 0 < p) (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc m N, ∑ d ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal,
      if d.1 = p then f d.2 else 0) =
      ∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, if m ≤ p * q ∧ p * q ≤ N then f q else 0

name: PrimeGap186.sum_Icc_inv_sq_le
statement:
theorem sum_Icc_inv_sq_le (N r : ℕ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) :
    (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc r N, (1 : ℝ) / (m : ℝ) ^ 2) ≤
      1 / ((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_Icc_single_eq_halfOpenSample_add_endpoint
statement:
theorem sum_Icc_single_eq_halfOpenSample_add_endpoint
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (f : ℕ → ℂ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc ⌈x⌉₊ ⌊2 * x⌋₊, Finsupp.single n (f n)) =
      halfOpenSample x f +
        if (⌊2 * x⌋₊ : ℝ) = 2 * x then Finsupp.single ⌊2 * x⌋₊ (f ⌊2 * x⌋₊) else 0

name: PrimeGap186.sum_Ico_card_divisors_pow_modEq_le
statement:
theorem sum_Ico_card_divisors_pow_modEq_le
    (Y K k X : ℕ) (hY : 2 ≤ Y) (hX : X ≤ Y ^ K)
    (b c q a : ℕ) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (hc : c ≤ X + 1)
    (hq : 0 < q) (ha : Nat.Coprime a q) :
    (∑ n ∈ (Finset.Ico b c).filter (fun n : ℕ => n % q = a % q),
      (n.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ k) ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (K * k) * (1 + Real.log (Y ^ 2 : ℕ)) ^ (2 ^ (K * k)) *
        (((c - b : ℕ) : ℝ) / q + (Y ^ 2 : ℕ))

name: PrimeGap186.sum_Ico_inv_eq_harmonic
statement:
theorem sum_Ico_inv_eq_harmonic (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ a ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (n + 1), ((a : ℝ))⁻¹) = (harmonic n : ℝ)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_Ico_one_div_nat_sq_le
statement:
theorem sum_Ico_one_div_nat_sq_le
    {D Q : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) (hDQ : D ≤ Q) :
    (∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico D Q, (1 : ℝ) / (m : ℝ) ^ 2) ≤
      2 / (D : ℝ)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_Ico_one_reflect
statement:
theorem sum_Ico_one_reflect (q : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 1 q, u (q - k)) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 1 q, u k

name: PrimeGap186.sum_Ioc_one_eq_sum_Icc_zero
statement:
theorem sum_Ioc_one_eq_sum_Icc_zero {f : ℕ → ℝ} {x : ℕ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hf1 : f 1 = 0)
  (hf0 : f 0 = 0) :
    ∑ n ∈ Ioc 1 x, f n = ∑ n ∈ Icc 0 x, f n

name: PrimeGap186.sum_Ioc_one_eq_sum_Ioc_zero
statement:
theorem sum_Ioc_one_eq_sum_Ioc_zero {f : ℕ → ℝ} {x : ℕ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hf : f 1 = 0) :
    ∑ n ∈ Ioc 1 x, f n = ∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 x, f n

name: PrimeGap186.sum_active_poles
statement:
theorem sum_active_poles {K E : Type*} [Field K] [Field E] (φ : K →+* E)
    (M : Finset K) (a : K → K) (x : E) :
    (∑ z ∈ M, φ (a z) / (x - φ z)) =
      ∑ z ∈ M.filter (fun z => a z ≠ 0), φ (a z) / (x - φ z)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_add_sum_lt_of_no_subset_sum_in_Icc
statement:
theorem sum_add_sum_lt_of_no_subset_sum_in_Icc {ι : Type*}
    (w : ι → ℝ) (A B : ℝ)
    (havoid : ∀ s : Finset ι, ¬ (A ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, w i ∧ ∑ i ∈ s, w i ≤ B))
    (s t : Finset ι) (hst : Disjoint s t) (hs : ∑ i ∈ s, w i < A)
    (ht : ∀ i ∈ t, w i ≤ B - A) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, w i) + ∑ i ∈ t, w i < A

name: PrimeGap186.sum_allModuli_log_sq_le
statement:
theorem sum_allModuli_log_sq_le
    (x Q : ℕ) (hx : 2 ≤ x) :
    (∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 Q,
      Real.log ((q * x : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) ≤
      (Q : ℝ) * Real.log ((Q * x : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2

name: PrimeGap186.sum_allModuli_maxCenteredProgressionDiscrepancyUpTo_le_log_sq_add_inducing
statement:
theorem
    sum_allModuli_maxCenteredProgressionDiscrepancyUpTo_le_log_sq_add_inducing
    (x Q : ℕ) (hx : 2 ≤ x) :
    (∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 Q,
      maxCenteredProgressionDiscrepancyUpTo x q) ≤
      (Q : ℝ) * Real.log ((Q * x : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 +
        ∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 Q,
          (q.totient : ℝ)⁻¹ *
            ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q,
              inducingPrimitiveCenteredEndpointMaximum x q χ

name: PrimeGap186.sum_cappedDyadicIntensity
statement:
theorem sum_cappedDyadicIntensity (ζ : ℝ) :
    Measure.sum (fun k : ℤ => (cappedDyadicIntensity ζ k : Measure ℝ)) =
      (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) ζ)).withDensity
        (fun u : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (1 / u))

name: PrimeGap186.sum_card_divisors_div_sq_eq_productPairSum
statement:
theorem sum_card_divisors_div_sq_eq_productPairSum (Q : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 Q, (n.divisors.card : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) =
      ∑ ab ∈ boundedPositiveProductPairs Q,
        (1 : ℝ) / ((ab.1 : ℝ) ^ 2 * (ab.2 : ℝ) ^ 2)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_card_divisors_div_sq_le_four
statement:
theorem sum_card_divisors_div_sq_le_four (Q : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 Q, (n.divisors.card : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) ≤ 4

name: PrimeGap186.sum_card_divisors_pow_div_le_log_pow
statement:
theorem sum_card_divisors_pow_div_le_log_pow (e Z : ℕ) :
    (∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 Z, (d.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ e / (d : ℝ)) ≤
      (1 + Real.log (Z : ℝ)) ^ (2 ^ e)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_card_divisors_pow_large_square_le
statement:
theorem sum_card_divisors_pow_large_square_le
    (K X Y : ℕ) (hY : 0 < Y) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 X with
        ∃ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Y < p ∧ p ^ 2 ∣ n,
      ((Nat.divisors n).card : ℝ) ^ K) ≤
      (3 : ℝ) ^ K * (X : ℝ) *
        (1 + Real.log (X : ℝ)) ^ (2 ^ K - 1) / (Y : ℝ)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_card_divisors_pow_le_mul_log_pow
statement:
theorem sum_card_divisors_pow_le_mul_log_pow (K X : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 X, ((Nat.divisors n).card : ℝ) ^ K) ≤
      (X : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (X : ℝ)) ^ (2 ^ K - 1)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_cast_div_le_squarefreeMoment_sq
statement:
theorem sum_cast_div_le_squarefreeMoment_sq (Z B : ℕ) :
    (∑ a ∈ (Finset.Ioc 0 Z).filter Squarefree,
      ∑ b ∈ (Finset.Ioc 0 Z).filter Squarefree,
        ((B / (a * b) : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
      (B : ℝ) *
        (∑ a ∈ (Finset.Ioc 0 Z).filter Squarefree, (a : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2

name: PrimeGap186.sum_character_mul_log_eq_sum_logIncrement_mul_suffixes
statement:
theorem sum_character_mul_log_eq_sum_logIncrement_mul_suffixes
    (H q : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) :
    (∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 H, χ h * (Real.log h : ℂ)) =
      ∑ a ∈ Finset.Icc 2 H,
        ((Real.log a - Real.log ((a - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          dirichletCharacterIntervalSum a H q χ

name: PrimeGap186.sum_characters_eq_sum_conductor_fibers
statement:
theorem sum_characters_eq_sum_conductor_fibers
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    (F : DirichletCharacter ℂ q → M) :
    (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, F χ) =
      ∑ d : q.divisors,
        ∑ χ : charactersOfConductor q d.1, F χ.1

name: PrimeGap186.sum_characters_eq_sum_divisor_primitive
statement:
theorem sum_characters_eq_sum_divisor_primitive
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    (F : DirichletCharacter ℂ q → M) :
    (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, F χ) =
      ∑ d : q.divisors,
        ∑ ψ : primitiveCharacters d.1,
          F (DirichletCharacter.changeLevel
            (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors d.2) ψ.1)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_characters_of_conductor_eq_sum_primitive
statement:
theorem sum_characters_of_conductor_eq_sum_primitive
    {q d : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (hd : d ∣ q)
    {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    (F : DirichletCharacter ℂ q → M) :
    (∑ χ : charactersOfConductor q d, F χ.1) =
      ∑ ψ : primitiveCharacters d,
        F (DirichletCharacter.changeLevel hd ψ.1)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_csc_sq_add_two_weight_le_inv_sq
statement:
theorem sum_csc_sq_add_two_weight_le_inv_sq
    (x : ι → ℝ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hsep : ∀ r s, r ≠ s →
      δ ≤ dist (x r : UnitAddCircle) (x s : UnitAddCircle))
    (s : ι) :
    (∑ r ∈ Finset.univ.erase s,
      (cosecantPi (x r - x s) ^ 2 + 2 * cscCotangentWeight x r s)) ≤
      δ⁻¹ ^ 2

name: PrimeGap186.sum_dirichletExplicitFormulaShallowCandidateContribution_eq_of_isPrimitive
statement:
theorem
    sum_dirichletExplicitFormulaShallowCandidateContribution_eq_of_isPrimitive
    {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (chi : DirichletCharacter ℂ q)
    (hchi : chi.IsPrimitive) (x T : ℝ) (hx : 1 < x) :
    (∑ rho ∈
        dirichletExplicitFormulaShallowCandidateSingularitiesFinset chi x T,
      dirichletExplicitFormulaCandidateContribution chi x rho) =
      (if chi = 1 then (x : ℂ) - 1 else 0) -
        dirichletNontrivialZeroKernelSum chi x T -
          (if chi ≠ 1 ∧ chi.Even then (Real.log x : ℂ) else 0)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_div_log_eq
statement:
theorem sum_div_log_eq {x : ℝ} (hx : 2 ≤ x) (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ n ∈ Ioc 1 ⌊x⌋₊, f n / log n =
      (∑ n ∈ Ioc 1 ⌊x⌋₊, f n) / log x + ∫ t in 2..x, (∑ n ∈ Ioc 1 ⌊t⌋₊, f n) / (t * log
        t ^ 2)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_divisor_weight_inv_totient_le_log
statement:
theorem sum_divisor_weight_inv_totient_le_log
    (Q J : ℕ) :
    (∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 Q,
      (q.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ J / (q.totient : ℝ)) ≤
        (1 + Real.log (Q : ℝ)) ^ (2 ^ (J + 1))

name: PrimeGap186.sum_divisor_weighted_log_saving_of_two_bounds
statement:
theorem sum_divisor_weighted_log_saving_of_two_bounds
    (S : Finset ℕ) (J : ℕ) (v : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ q ∈ S, 0 ≤ v q)
    (x L A K0 K1 : ℝ) (P : ℕ)
    (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hL : 0 < L) (hK0 : 0 < K0) (hK1 : 0 < K1)
    (hsmall : (∑ q ∈ S, v q) ≤ K0 * x / L ^ (2 * A + (P : ℝ)))
    (hlarge : (∑ q ∈ S, (q.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ (2 * J) * v q) ≤
      K1 * x * L ^ P) :
    (∑ q ∈ S, (q.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ J * v q) ≤
      (K0 + K1) * x / L ^ A

name: PrimeGap186.sum_divisor_weighted_nonnegative_sq_le
statement:
theorem sum_divisor_weighted_nonnegative_sq_le
    (S : Finset ℕ) (J : ℕ) (v : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ q ∈ S, 0 ≤ v q) :
    (∑ q ∈ S, (q.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ J * v q) ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ q ∈ S, v q) *
        ∑ q ∈ S, (q.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ (2 * J) * v q

name: PrimeGap186.sum_divisorsAntidiagonal_mul_prime
statement:
theorem sum_divisorsAntidiagonal_mul_prime
    {α : Type*} [AddCommMonoid α] (p m : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p)
    (hcop : Nat.Coprime p m) (F : ℕ → ℕ → α) :
    (∑ d ∈ (p * m).divisorsAntidiagonal, F d.1 d.2) =
      ∑ d ∈ m.divisorsAntidiagonal, (F (p * d.1) d.2 + F d.1 (p * d.2))

name: PrimeGap186.sum_divisorsAntidiagonal_up_to_eq_sum_positiveFactorPairs
statement:
theorem sum_divisorsAntidiagonal_up_to_eq_sum_positiveFactorPairs
    {Q : ℕ} {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    (f : ℕ → ℕ → M) :
    (∑ q ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 Q,
      ∑ p ∈ q.divisorsAntidiagonal, f p.1 p.2) =
      ∑ p ∈ positiveFactorPairs Q, f p.1 p.2

name: PrimeGap186.sum_divisorsAntidiagonal_up_to_eq_sum_secondTermFactorPairs
statement:
theorem sum_divisorsAntidiagonal_up_to_eq_sum_secondTermFactorPairs
    {y : ℕ} {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : ℕ → ℕ → M) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 y,
      ∑ p ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, f p.1 p.2) =
      ∑ p ∈ vaughanSecondTermFactorPairs y, f p.1 p.2

name: PrimeGap186.sum_divisors_up_to_eq_sum_positiveFactorPairs
statement:
theorem sum_divisors_up_to_eq_sum_positiveFactorPairs
    {Q : ℕ} {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    (f : ℕ → ℕ → M) :
    (∑ q ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 Q,
      ∑ d ∈ q.divisors, f q d) =
      ∑ p ∈ positiveFactorPairs Q,
        f (p.1 * p.2) p.1

name: PrimeGap186.sum_eq_sum_dyadicBlocks
statement:
theorem sum_eq_sum_dyadicBlocks
    {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A] {X : ℕ}
    (s : Finset ℕ) (hs : ∀ t ∈ s, 2 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ X)
    (f : ℕ → A) :
    (∑ t ∈ s, f t) =
      ∑ alpha ∈ dyadicExponentRange X,
        ∑ t ∈ s.filter (fun t ↦ t ∈ dyadicBlock alpha), f t

name: PrimeGap186.sum_erase_eq_sum_ite
statement:
theorem sum_erase_eq_sum_ite (a : ι) (f : ι → ℂ) :
    ∑ b ∈ Finset.univ.erase a, f b = ∑ b, if b = a then 0 else f b

name: PrimeGap186.sum_finMulAntidiag_one_weighted
statement:
theorem sum_finMulAntidiag_one_weighted
    {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A] (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) (w : (Fin 1 → ℕ) → A) :
    (∑ p ∈ Nat.finMulAntidiag 1 n, w p) = w (fun _ => n)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_finMulAntidiag_succ_weighted
statement:
theorem sum_finMulAntidiag_succ_weighted
    {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A] (k n : ℕ) (w : (Fin (k + 1) → ℕ) → A) :
    (∑ p ∈ Nat.finMulAntidiag (k + 1) n, w p) =
      ∑ d ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, ∑ p ∈ Nat.finMulAntidiag k d.2,
        w (Fin.cons d.1 p)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_fin_mul_eq_sum_fin_prod
statement:
theorem sum_fin_mul_eq_sum_fin_prod {m n : ℕ} (f : Fin (m * n) → ℤ) :
    (∑ j : Fin (m * n), f j) =
      ∑ b : Fin m, ∑ k : Fin n, f (finProdFinEquiv (b, k))

name: PrimeGap186.sum_five_prime_tuple_indicator_le
statement:
theorem sum_five_prime_tuple_indicator_le
    (n : ℕ) (P : (Fin 5 → ℕ) → Prop) [DecidablePred P]
    (hprod : ∀ p ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin 5 => Nat.primesLE n),
      P p → (∏ i, p i) = n) :
    (∑ p ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin 5 => Nat.primesLE n),
      if P p then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ 3125

name: PrimeGap186.sum_four_divisorsAntidiagonal
statement:
theorem sum_four_divisorsAntidiagonal
    {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A] (n : ℕ) (w : (Fin 5 → ℕ) → A) :
    (∑ d ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, ∑ e ∈ d.2.divisorsAntidiagonal,
      ∑ f ∈ e.2.divisorsAntidiagonal, ∑ g ∈ f.2.divisorsAntidiagonal,
        w ![d.1, e.1, f.1, g.1, g.2]) =
      ∑ p ∈ Nat.finMulAntidiag 5 n, w p

name: PrimeGap186.sum_four_divisors_mul_prime
statement:
theorem sum_four_divisors_mul_prime
    {α : Type*} [AddCommMonoid α] (p m : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p)
    (hcop : Nat.Coprime p m) (F : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → α) :
    (∑ a ∈ (p * m).divisorsAntidiagonal,
      ∑ b ∈ a.2.divisorsAntidiagonal, ∑ c ∈ b.2.divisorsAntidiagonal,
        F a.1 b.1 c.1 c.2) =
      ∑ a ∈ m.divisorsAntidiagonal, ∑ b ∈ a.2.divisorsAntidiagonal,
        ∑ c ∈ b.2.divisorsAntidiagonal,
          (F (p * a.1) b.1 c.1 c.2 + F a.1 (p * b.1) c.1 c.2 +
            F a.1 b.1 (p * c.1) c.2 + F a.1 b.1 c.1 (p * c.2))

name: PrimeGap186.sum_four_linear_terms
statement:
theorem sum_four_linear_terms {α : Type*} (T : Finset α) (f0 f1 f2 f3 : α → ℝ)
    (c d e : ℝ) :
    c * (∑ i ∈ T, f0 i) + d * (∑ i ∈ T, f1 i) + d * (∑ i ∈ T, f2 i) + e * (∑ i ∈ T, f3 i) =
      ∑ i ∈ T, (c * f0 i + d * f1 i + d * f2 i + e * f3 i)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_four_prime_divisorsAntidiagonal
statement:
theorem sum_four_prime_divisorsAntidiagonal {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A]
    (n : ℕ) (w : (Fin 4 → ℕ) → A) :
    (∑ a ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, ∑ b ∈ a.2.divisorsAntidiagonal,
      ∑ c ∈ b.2.divisorsAntidiagonal,
        if a.1.Prime ∧ b.1.Prime ∧ c.1.Prime ∧ c.2.Prime then
          w ![a.1, b.1, c.1, c.2] else 0) =
      ∑ p ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin 4 => Nat.primesLE n),
        if (∏ i, p i) = n then w p else 0

name: PrimeGap186.sum_four_prime_divisorsAntidiagonal_residual_first
statement:
theorem sum_four_prime_divisorsAntidiagonal_residual_first
    {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A] (n : ℕ) (w : (Fin 4 → ℕ) → A) :
    (∑ a ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, ∑ b ∈ a.2.divisorsAntidiagonal,
      ∑ c ∈ b.2.divisorsAntidiagonal,
        if a.1.Prime ∧ b.1.Prime ∧ c.1.Prime ∧ c.2.Prime then
          w ![c.2, a.1, b.1, c.1] else 0) =
      ∑ p ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin 4 => Nat.primesLE n),
        if (∏ i, p i) = n then w p else 0

name: PrimeGap186.sum_fragmentBandMasses
statement:
theorem sum_fragmentBandMasses {m : ℕ} (a : Fin (m + 2) → ℝ)
    (ha : Monotone a) (c : FiniteMeasure ℝ) :
    (∑ j, fragmentBandMasses a c j) =
      ((c.restrict (Set.Ioc (a 0) (a (Fin.last (m + 1))))).mass : ℝ)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_functions_eq_sum_finpartitions_embeddings
statement:
theorem sum_functions_eq_sum_finpartitions_embeddings
    {α β R : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype β] [AddCommMonoid R]
    (F : (α → β) → R) :
    (∑ f : α → β, F f) =
      ∑ π : Finpartition (Finset.univ : Finset α),
        ∑ e : π.parts ↪ β,
          F (fun a => e ⟨π.part a, π.part_mem.mpr (Finset.mem_univ a)⟩)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_gcd_mul_eq_sum_totient_mul
statement:
theorem sum_gcd_mul_eq_sum_totient_mul (a T : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (u : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, (Nat.gcd a k : ℝ) * u k) =
      ∑ d ∈ a.divisors, ∑ k ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T).filter (fun k => d ∣ k),
        (Nat.totient d : ℝ) * u k

name: PrimeGap186.sum_gcd_mul_inv_le_card_divisors_mul_one_add_log
statement:
theorem sum_gcd_mul_inv_le_card_divisors_mul_one_add_log (a T : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, (Nat.gcd a k : ℝ) * (k : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
      (a.divisors.card : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (T : ℝ))

name: PrimeGap186.sum_inducingPrimitiveCenteredEndpointMaximum_eq_divisors
statement:
theorem sum_inducingPrimitiveCenteredEndpointMaximum_eq_divisors
    {x q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q,
      inducingPrimitiveCenteredEndpointMaximum x q χ) =
      ∑ d : q.divisors,
        ∑ ψ : primitiveCharacters d.1,
          primitiveCenteredEndpointMaximum x d.1 ψ

name: PrimeGap186.sum_insertNth_product_map_eq
statement:
theorem sum_insertNth_product_map_eq {E : Type*} {n : ℕ} (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (F F' : (Fin (n + 1) → E) → ℝ)
    (V : ℕ → E) (Q : Finset ℕ) :
    (∑ r ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin (n + 1 + 1) => Q), (∏ j, (Nat.totient (r j) : ℝ)⁻¹) *
      (if Squarefree (∏ j : Fin (n + 1), r j.castSucc) ∧
          Squarefree ((∏ j : Fin n, r j.castSucc.castSucc) * r (Fin.last (n + 1))) then
        (F (fun l => V (i.insertNth (α := fun _ => ℕ) (r (Fin.last n).castSucc)
                (Fin.init (Fin.init r)) l)) *
            F' (fun l => V (i.insertNth (α := fun _ => ℕ) (r (Fin.last (n + 1)))
                (Fin.init (Fin.init r)) l))) else 0)) =
    (∑ r ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin (n + 1 + 1) => Q), (∏ j, (Nat.totient (r j) : ℝ)⁻¹) *
      (if Squarefree (∏ j : Fin (n + 1), r j.castSucc) ∧
          Squarefree ((∏ j : Fin n, r j.castSucc.castSucc) * r (Fin.last (n + 1))) then
        (F (i.insertNth (V (r (Fin.last n).castSucc)) (Fin.init (Fin.init (fun j => V (r j))))) *
            F' (i.insertNth (V (r (Fin.last (n + 1)))) (Fin.init (Fin.init (fun j => V (r j))))))
        else 0))

name: PrimeGap186.sum_interval_invTotient_primitiveRaw_eq_meanValueWeight_div
statement:
theorem sum_interval_invTotient_primitiveRaw_eq_meanValueWeight_div
    (x Q : ℕ) (Q1 : ℝ) :
    (∑ q ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊Q1⌋₊ Q,
      (q.totient : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ∑ ψ : primitiveCharacters q,
          primitiveRawEndpointMaximum x q ψ) =
      ∑ q ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊Q1⌋₊ Q,
        primitiveRawMeanValueWeight x q / (q : ℝ)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_inv_abs_sub_lower
statement:
theorem sum_inv_abs_sub_lower (x : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico 1 x,
      |(x : ℝ) - n|⁻¹) = (harmonic (x - 1) : ℝ)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_inv_abs_sub_upper
statement:
theorem sum_inv_abs_sub_upper (x : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico (x + 1) (2 * x),
      |(x : ℝ) - n|⁻¹) = (harmonic (x - 1) : ℝ)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_inv_le_two_of_subset_dyadic_Icc
statement:
theorem sum_inv_le_two_of_subset_dyadic_Icc
    (I : Finset ℕ) (R : ℕ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (hI : I ⊆ Finset.Icc R (2 * R)) :
    (∑ r ∈ I, (r : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤ 2

name: PrimeGap186.sum_inv_sq_circle_dist_le
statement:
theorem sum_inv_sq_circle_dist_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (y : ι → UnitAddCircle) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hsep : ∀ r s, r ≠ s → δ ≤ dist (y r) (y s)) (i : ι) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (dist (y i) (y j) ^ 2)⁻¹) ≤
      Real.pi ^ 2 / (3 * δ ^ 2)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_inv_sq_circle_dist_lt
statement:
theorem sum_inv_sq_circle_dist_lt {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (y : ι → UnitAddCircle) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hsep : ∀ r s, r ≠ s → δ ≤ dist (y r) (y s)) (i : ι) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (dist (y i) (y j) ^ 2)⁻¹) <
      Real.pi ^ 2 / (3 * δ ^ 2)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_inv_sqrt_factoredNumbers_le_divisors_sq
statement:
theorem sum_inv_sqrt_factoredNumbers_le_divisors_sq
    (t : ℕ) (ht : t ≠ 0) (S : Finset ℕ)
    (hS : ∀ u ∈ S, u ∈ Nat.factoredNumbers t.primeFactors) :
    (∑ u ∈ S, (Real.sqrt (u : ℝ))⁻¹) ≤ (t.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ 2

name: PrimeGap186.sum_inv_squarefree_eq_moebiusSquareMoment
statement:
theorem sum_inv_squarefree_eq_moebiusSquareMoment (Z : ℕ) :
    (∑ a ∈ (Finset.Ioc 0 Z).filter Squarefree, (a : ℝ)⁻¹) =
      ∑ a ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 Z,
        (((ArithmeticFunction.moebius a : ℤ) : ℝ)) ^ 2 / (a : ℝ)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_inv_totient_mul_le_inv_totient_mul_sum
statement:
theorem sum_inv_totient_mul_le_inv_totient_mul_sum
    (Q d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 (Q / d),
      ((d * k).totient : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
      (d.totient : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 (Q / d),
          (k.totient : ℝ)⁻¹

name: PrimeGap186.sum_inv_vaughanSecondTermIndices_le_one_add_log
statement:
theorem sum_inv_vaughanSecondTermIndices_le_one_add_log
    {V : ℝ} (hV : 1 ≤ V) (y : ℕ) :
    (∑ d ∈ vaughanSecondTermIndices V y, ((d : ℝ))⁻¹) ≤
      1 + Real.log V

name: PrimeGap186.sum_log_eq_sum_mangoldt
statement:
theorem sum_log_eq_sum_mangoldt {x : ℝ} :
    ∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, log n = ∑ d ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, Λ d * ⌊x / d⌋₊

name: PrimeGap186.sum_log_ge
statement:
theorem sum_log_ge {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    ∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, log n ≥ x * log x - 2 * x

name: PrimeGap186.sum_log_le
statement:
theorem sum_log_le {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    ∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, log n ≤ x * log x

name: PrimeGap186.sum_log_prime_div_eq
statement:
theorem sum_log_prime_div_eq (x : ℝ) : ∑ p ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊ with p.Prime, (log p) / p
  = log x + primeLogError x

name: PrimeGap186.sum_log_sub_log_natPred_Icc
statement:
theorem sum_log_sub_log_natPred_Icc (H : ℕ) :
    (∑ a ∈ Finset.Icc 2 H,
      (Real.log a - Real.log ((a - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) = Real.log H

name: PrimeGap186.sum_lt_of_card_le_two
statement:
theorem sum_lt_of_card_le_two {ι : Type*}
    (w : ι → ℝ) (A : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) (hw : ∀ i, w i < A)
    (hpair : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → w i + w j < A)
    (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.card ≤ 2) : ∑ i ∈ s, w i < A

name: PrimeGap186.sum_mangoldt_div_eq
statement:
theorem sum_mangoldt_div_eq (x : ℝ) : ∑ d ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, (Λ d) / d = log x +
  mangoldtLogError x

name: PrimeGap186.sum_mangoldt_div_eq_log
statement:
theorem sum_mangoldt_div_eq_log {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    |∑ d ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, (Λ d) / d - log x| ≤ log 4 + 4

name: PrimeGap186.sum_maxCenteredProgressionDiscrepancyUpTo_le_log_sq_add_small_add_large
statement:
theorem
    sum_maxCenteredProgressionDiscrepancyUpTo_le_log_sq_add_small_add_large
    (x Q R : ℕ) (hx : 2 ≤ x) :
    (∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 Q,
      maxCenteredProgressionDiscrepancyUpTo x q) ≤
      (Q : ℝ) * Real.log ((Q * x : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 +
        smallConductorCenteredMass x Q R +
          largeConductorCenteredMass x Q R

name: PrimeGap186.sum_max_masked_finiteConvolution_discrepancy_le_conductor_sum
statement:
theorem sum_max_masked_finiteConvolution_discrepancy_le_conductor_sum
    (α β : ℕ →₀ ℂ) (Q h : ℕ) :
    (∑ q ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 Q,
      ⨆ a : (ZMod q)ˣ,
        ‖fullDiscrepancy
          ((finiteConvolution α β).filter (fun n : ℕ => Nat.Coprime n h))
          q (a : ZMod q).val‖) ≤
      ∑ e ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 Q, (e.totient : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ∑ f ∈ Finset.Ioc 1 (Q / e), (f.totient : ℝ)⁻¹ *
          ∑ ψ ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ f)).filter
              (fun ψ => ψ.IsPrimitive),
            ‖(∑ m ∈ α.support,
                if Nat.Coprime m (e * h) then α m * ψ (m : ZMod f) else 0) *
              (∑ n ∈ β.support,
                if Nat.Coprime n (e * h) then β n * ψ (n : ZMod f) else 0)‖

name: PrimeGap186.sum_meanValueWeight_div_eq_rawPrimitiveAbel
statement:
theorem sum_meanValueWeight_div_eq_rawPrimitiveAbel
    (x : ℕ) (Q1 Q : ℝ) (hQ1 : 1 ≤ Q1) (hQ : Q1 ≤ Q) :
    (∑ q ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊Q1⌋₊ ⌊Q⌋₊,
      primitiveRawMeanValueWeight x q / (q : ℝ)) =
      Q⁻¹ * primitiveRawMeanValueCumulative x Q -
        Q1⁻¹ * primitiveRawMeanValueCumulative x Q1 +
          ∫ t in Set.Ioc Q1 Q,
            primitiveRawMeanValueCumulative x t / t ^ 2

name: PrimeGap186.sum_meanValueWeight_div_eq_rawPrimitiveAbel_natUpper
statement:
theorem sum_meanValueWeight_div_eq_rawPrimitiveAbel_natUpper
    (x Q : ℕ) (Q1 : ℝ) (hQ1 : 1 ≤ Q1)
    (hQ : Q1 ≤ (Q : ℝ)) :
    (∑ q ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊Q1⌋₊ Q,
      primitiveRawMeanValueWeight x q / (q : ℝ)) =
      (Q : ℝ)⁻¹ * primitiveRawMeanValueCumulative x Q -
        Q1⁻¹ * primitiveRawMeanValueCumulative x Q1 +
          ∫ t in Set.Ioc Q1 (Q : ℝ),
            primitiveRawMeanValueCumulative x t / t ^ 2

name: PrimeGap186.sum_measureReal_adjacent_Ioc
statement:
theorem sum_measureReal_adjacent_Ioc {n : ℕ} (a : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (ha : Monotone a) (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] :
    (∑ j : Fin n, μ.real (Set.Ioc (a j.castSucc) (a j.succ))) =
      μ.real (Set.Ioc (a 0) (a (Fin.last n)))

name: PrimeGap186.sum_moebius_divisors_eq_coprimeIndicator
statement:
theorem sum_moebius_divisors_eq_coprimeIndicator
    {n r : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hr : 0 < r) :
    (∑ a ∈ r.divisors,
      if a ∣ n then
        ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius a : ℤ) : ℂ)
      else 0) =
      if n.Coprime r then 1 else 0

name: PrimeGap186.sum_moebius_divisors_gcd
statement:
theorem sum_moebius_divisors_gcd
    {m P : ℕ} :
    (∑ d ∈ (m.gcd P).divisors,
      ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℤ) : ℝ)) =
      if Nat.Coprime m P then 1 else 0

name: PrimeGap186.sum_multiples_character
statement:
theorem sum_multiples_character
    {d a Y : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (psi : DirichletCharacter ℂ d) :
    (∑ n ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 Y).filter (fun n ↦ a ∣ n), psi n) =
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (Y / a), psi (a * m)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_natCast_le_finsum_intCast
statement:
theorem sum_natCast_le_finsum_intCast
    {α : Type*} (S : Finset α) (m : α → ℕ) (D : α → ℤ)
    (hDfinite : D.support.Finite) (hDnonneg : 0 ≤ D)
    (hm : ∀ a ∈ S, (m a : ℤ) ≤ D a) :
    (∑ a ∈ S, (m a : ℝ)) ≤ ((∑ᶠ a, D a : ℤ) : ℝ)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_natCast_le_finsum_intCast_pair
statement:
theorem sum_natCast_le_finsum_intCast_pair
    {α : Type*} (S : Finset α) (m : α → ℕ)
    (D₁ D₂ : α → ℤ)
    (hD₁finite : D₁.support.Finite) (hD₂finite : D₂.support.Finite)
    (hD₁nonneg : 0 ≤ D₁) (hD₂nonneg : 0 ≤ D₂)
    (hm : ∀ a ∈ S, (m a : ℤ) ≤ D₁ a + D₂ a) :
    (∑ a ∈ S, (m a : ℝ)) ≤
      ((∑ᶠ a, D₁ a : ℤ) : ℝ) + ((∑ᶠ a, D₂ a : ℤ) : ℝ)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_nontrivial_candidateContribution_eq_neg_kernelSum
statement:
theorem sum_nontrivial_candidateContribution_eq_neg_kernelSum
    {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (chi : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (x T : ℝ) :
    (∑ rho ∈ dirichletNontrivialLFunctionZerosFinset chi T,
      dirichletExplicitFormulaCandidateContribution chi x rho) =
        -dirichletNontrivialZeroKernelSum chi x T

name: PrimeGap186.sum_norm_closed_heathBrown_discrepancy_le
statement:
theorem sum_norm_closed_heathBrown_discrepancy_le
    (K : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K) (U x : ℝ)
    (hU : 0 ≤ U) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hcut : 2 * x ≤ U ^ K)
    (S : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℕ) :
    (∑ q ∈ S, ‖fullDiscrepancy
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc ⌈x⌉₊ ⌊2 * x⌋₊,
        Finsupp.single n ((ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℝ) : ℂ))
      q (a q)‖) ≤
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range K, (K.choose (j + 1) : ℝ) *
        ∑ q ∈ S, ‖fullDiscrepancy
          (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc ⌈x⌉₊ ⌊2 * x⌋₊,
            Finsupp.single n
              (((arithmeticFunctionLowCutoff U
                  (ArithmeticFunction.moebius : ArithmeticFunction ℝ)) ^ (j + 1) *
                (ArithmeticFunction.zeta : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) ^ j *
                  ArithmeticFunction.log) n : ℂ))
          q (a q)‖

name: PrimeGap186.sum_norm_dispersion_le_global_average
statement:
theorem sum_norm_dispersion_le_global_average
    (f : ℕ →₀ ℂ) {G : ℕ} (hG : 0 < G)
    (S : Finset (ℕ × ℕ))
    (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, Nat.Coprime p.1 p.2 ∧ p.1 ∣ G) (a : ℕ) :
    (∑ p ∈ S, ‖dispersionTerm f p.1 p.2 a‖) ≤
      (∑ b ∈ primitiveResidues G,
        ∑ p ∈ S, ‖deltaZero f p.1 p.2 a a b‖) /
          (G.totient : ℝ)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_norm_le_sqrt_card_mul_sqrt_sum_sq
statement:
theorem sum_norm_le_sqrt_card_mul_sqrt_sum_sq
    {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (a : α → ℂ) :
    (∑ x ∈ s, ‖a x‖) ≤
      Real.sqrt (s.card : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (∑ x ∈ s, ‖a x‖ ^ 2)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_norm_le_sqrt_span_mul_sqrt_sum_sq
statement:
theorem sum_norm_le_sqrt_span_mul_sqrt_sum_sq
    {m0 M : ℕ} (s : Finset ℕ)
    (hs : s ⊆ Finset.Ioc m0 (m0 + M)) (a : ℕ → ℂ) :
    (∑ x ∈ s, ‖a x‖) ≤
      Real.sqrt (M : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (∑ x ∈ s, ‖a x‖ ^ 2)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_norm_meanTerm_le_harmonic_of_masked_bv
statement:
theorem sum_norm_meanTerm_le_harmonic_of_masked_bv
    (f : ℕ →₀ ℂ) (U V s : ℕ) (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (S : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) (a : ℕ)
    (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, 0 < p.1 ∧ p.1 ≤ U ∧ 0 < p.2 ∧ p.2 ≤ V ∧
      Nat.Coprime p.1 p.2 ∧ Nat.Coprime a (p.1 * p.2))
    (hBV : ∀ q : ℕ, 0 < q → q ≤ U →
      (∑ r ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 V,
        ⨆ b : (ZMod r)ˣ,
          ‖fullDiscrepancy (f.filter (fun n => Nat.Coprime n q))
            r (b : ZMod r).val‖) ≤ K * (q.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ s) :
    (∑ p ∈ S, ‖meanTerm f p.1 p.2 a‖) ≤
      K * (harmonic U : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ (s + 1))

name: PrimeGap186.sum_norm_prime_interval_le_of_joint_log_prefix_bound
PrimeGap186.sum_norm_sq_dft
statement:
theorem sum_norm_sq_dft {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (f : ZMod q → ℂ) :
    (∑ k : ZMod q, ‖ZMod.dft f k‖ ^ 2) =
      (q : ℝ) * ∑ j : ZMod q, ‖f j‖ ^ 2

name: PrimeGap186.sum_norm_sq_dirichletCharacter
statement:
theorem sum_norm_sq_dirichletCharacter {q : ℕ} [NeZero q]
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) :
    (∑ j : ZMod q, ‖χ j‖ ^ 2) = (Nat.totient q : ℝ)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_norm_sq_dirichletCharacterUnitTransform
statement:
theorem sum_norm_sq_dirichletCharacterUnitTransform
    {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (b : (ZMod q)ˣ → ℂ) :
    (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q,
      ‖dirichletCharacterUnitTransform b χ‖ ^ 2) =
      (q.totient : ℝ) * ∑ a : (ZMod q)ˣ, ‖b a‖ ^ 2

name: PrimeGap186.sum_norm_sq_le_of_divisor_power_bound
statement:
theorem sum_norm_sq_le_of_divisor_power_bound (β : ℕ →₀ ℂ) (N k : ℕ) (B H : ℝ)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hH : 0 ≤ H) (hβ : β.support ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 N)
    (henv : ∀ n ∈ β.support,
      ‖β n‖ ≤ B * ((Nat.divisors n).card : ℝ) ^ k * H) :
    (∑ n ∈ β.support, ‖β n‖ ^ 2) ≤
      B ^ 2 * H ^ 2 * (N : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (N : ℝ)) ^ (2 ^ (2 * k) - 1)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_norm_sq_primitiveCharacterUnitTransform_le
statement:
theorem sum_norm_sq_primitiveCharacterUnitTransform_le
    {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (b : (ZMod q)ˣ → ℂ) :
    (∑ ψ : primitiveCharacters q,
      ‖dirichletCharacterUnitTransform b ψ.1‖ ^ 2) ≤
      (q.totient : ℝ) * ∑ a : (ZMod q)ˣ, ‖b a‖ ^ 2

name: PrimeGap186.sum_norm_sq_reducedFraction_stdAddChar_Ioc_le
statement:
theorem sum_norm_sq_reducedFraction_stdAddChar_Ioc_le
    (Q m0 N : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℂ) :
    (∑ z : reducedFractionIndices Q,
      ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc m0 (m0 + N),
        c n * ZMod.stdAddChar
          ((z.2 : ZMod z.1.1) * (n : ZMod z.1.1))‖ ^ 2) ≤
      ((N : ℝ) + (Q : ℝ) ^ 2) *
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc m0 (m0 + N), ‖c n‖ ^ 2

name: PrimeGap186.sum_norm_sq_unitAddCircleAddChar_Ioc_le
statement:
theorem sum_norm_sq_unitAddCircleAddChar_Ioc_le
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (x : ι → UnitAddCircle) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hsep : ∀ r s, r ≠ s → δ ≤ dist (x r) (x s))
    (m0 N : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℂ) :
    (∑ r, ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc m0 (m0 + N),
      c n * unitAddCircleAddChar (n • x r)‖ ^ 2) ≤
      ((N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹) *
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc m0 (m0 + N), ‖c n‖ ^ 2

name: PrimeGap186.sum_norm_sq_vaughanFourthCoefficient_Ioc_le
statement:
theorem sum_norm_sq_vaughanFourthCoefficient_Ioc_le
    {V : ℝ} {x M : ℕ} (hV : 1 ≤ V) (hM : 0 < M) :
    (∑ k ∈ (Finset.Ioc 0 (x / M)).filter
      (fun k : ℕ => V < (k : ℝ)),
      ‖(vaughanFourthCoefficient V k : ℂ)‖ ^ 2) ≤
      4 * (x : ℝ) / (3 * (M : ℝ)) *
        (Real.log (Real.exp 3 * V)) ^ 2

name: PrimeGap186.sum_norm_sq_vaughanThirdCoefficient_dyadic_le
statement:
theorem sum_norm_sq_vaughanThirdCoefficient_dyadic_le
    (U V : ℝ) (x alpha : ℕ) :
    (∑ t ∈ vaughanThirdLargeDyadicIndices U V x alpha,
      ‖((vaughanThirdCoefficient U V t : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ^ 2) ≤
      ((2 ^ alpha : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        (Real.log (2 * ((2 ^ alpha : ℕ) : ℝ))) ^ 2

name: PrimeGap186.sum_norm_sq_vonMangoldt_vaughanFourthDyadic_le_of_psi
statement:
theorem sum_norm_sq_vonMangoldt_vaughanFourthDyadic_le_of_psi
    {A U V : ℝ} (_hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hpsi : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 ≤ z → Chebyshev.psi z ≤ A * z)
    (x alpha : ℕ) :
    (∑ m ∈ vaughanFourthDyadicMIndices U V x alpha,
      ‖((ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt m : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ^ 2) ≤
      2 * A * (2 ^ alpha : ℕ) *
        Real.log (2 * ((2 ^ alpha : ℕ) : ℝ))

name: PrimeGap186.sum_pair_count_eq_filter_lcm
statement:
theorem sum_pair_count_eq_filter_lcm (Z A B : ℕ) :
    (∑ d ∈ positiveNaturalsUpTo Z, ∑ e ∈ positiveNaturalsUpTo Z,
      moebiusReal d * moebiusReal e *
        ((((Finset.Ioc A B).filter
          (fun n => Nat.lcm d e ∣ n)).card : ℕ) : ℝ)) =
      ∑ d ∈ positiveNaturalsUpTo Z,
        ∑ e ∈ (positiveNaturalsUpTo Z).filter (fun e => Nat.lcm d e ≤ B),
          moebiusReal d * moebiusReal e *
            ((((Finset.Ioc A B).filter
              (fun n => Nat.lcm d e ∣ n)).card : ℕ) : ℝ)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_pair_list_divisorsAntidiagonal
statement:
theorem sum_pair_list_divisorsAntidiagonal
    {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A]
    (F : Finset (List ℕ))
    (hshape : ∀ ps ∈ F, ∃ p q : ℕ, ps = [p, q])
    (w : List ℕ → ℕ → A) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ ps ∈ F, ∑ d ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal,
      if d.1 = ps.prod then w ps d.2 else 0) =
      ∑ a ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, ∑ b ∈ a.2.divisorsAntidiagonal,
        if [a.1, b.1] ∈ F then w [a.1, b.1] b.2 else 0

name: PrimeGap186.sum_phase_Ioc
statement:
theorem sum_phase_Ioc (t : ℝ) (ht : (t : UnitAddCircle) ≠ 0)
    (m0 N : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc m0 (m0 + N),
      (Real.fourierChar ((n : ℝ) * t) : ℂ)) =
      (Real.fourierChar (((m0 : ℝ) + 1) * t) : ℂ) *
        ((1 - (Real.fourierChar ((N : ℝ) * t) : ℂ)) / (1 - (Real.fourierChar t : ℂ)))

name: PrimeGap186.sum_phase_Ioc_eq_cosecant
statement:
theorem sum_phase_Ioc_eq_cosecant
    (t : ℝ) (ht : (t : UnitAddCircle) ≠ 0) (m0 N : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc m0 (m0 + N), (Real.fourierChar ((n : ℝ) * t) : ℂ)) =
      Complex.I / 2 *
        ((Real.fourierChar (((m0 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * t) : ℂ) -
          (Real.fourierChar ((((m0 + N : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * t) : ℂ)) *
        (((Real.sin (Real.pi * t))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_phase_norm_sq_Ioc_le
statement:
theorem sum_phase_norm_sq_Ioc_le
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (y : ι → ℝ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hsep : ∀ r s, r ≠ s →
      δ ≤ dist (y r : UnitAddCircle) (y s : UnitAddCircle))
    (m0 N : ℕ) (v : ι → ℂ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc m0 (m0 + N),
      ‖∑ r, (Real.fourierChar ((n : ℝ) * y r) : ℂ) * v r‖ ^ 2) ≤
      ((N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹) * ∑ r, ‖v r‖ ^ 2

name: PrimeGap186.sum_phase_norm_sq_eq_diag_add_offDiagonal
statement:
theorem sum_phase_norm_sq_eq_diag_add_offDiagonal
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (S : Finset ℕ) (y : ι → ℝ) (v : ι → ℂ) :
    (((∑ n ∈ S, ‖∑ r, (Real.fourierChar ((n : ℝ) * y r) : ℂ) * v r‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
      ((S.card : ℝ) * ∑ r, ‖v r‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) +
        ∑ r, ∑ s ∈ Finset.univ.erase r,
          v r * star (v s) *
            ∑ n ∈ S, (Real.fourierChar ((n : ℝ) * (y r - y s)) : ℂ)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_phase_norm_sq_expand
statement:
theorem sum_phase_norm_sq_expand
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (S : Finset ℕ) (y : ι → ℝ) (v : ι → ℂ) :
    (((∑ n ∈ S, ‖∑ r, (Real.fourierChar ((n : ℝ) * y r) : ℂ) * v r‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
      ∑ r, ∑ s,
        v r * star (v s) *
          ∑ n ∈ S, (Real.fourierChar ((n : ℝ) * (y r - y s)) : ℂ)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_piFinset_snoc
statement:
theorem sum_piFinset_snoc {α β : Type*} [AddCommMonoid β]
    (n : ℕ) (s : Finset α) (F : (Fin (n + 1) → α) → β) :
    (∑ p ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => s), F p) =
      ∑ p ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin n => s), ∑ q ∈ s, F (Fin.snoc p q)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_pi_snoc
statement:
theorem sum_pi_snoc {n : ℕ} (Q : Finset ℕ) (f : (Fin (n + 1) → ℕ) → ℝ) :
    (∑ u ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => Q), f u) =
      ∑ r ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin n => Q), ∑ s ∈ Q, f (Fin.snoc r s)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_pole_masked_affine_phase_chineseRemainder
statement:
theorem sum_pole_masked_affine_phase_chineseRemainder
    (r s : ℕ) [NeZero r] [NeZero s] (hrs : r.Coprime s)
    (A B L η₁ η₂ h k : ZMod (r * s)) :
    let e := ZMod.chineseRemainder hrs
    let F₁ : ZMod (r * s) → ZMod (r * s) → ZMod (r * s) :=
      fun n d => n + B * d + η₁
    let F₂ : ZMod (r * s) → ZMod (r * s) → ZMod (r * s) :=
      fun n d => n + (B + L) * d + η₂
    let F₁r : ZMod r → ZMod r → ZMod r :=
      fun n d => n + (e B).1 * d + (e η₁).1
    let F₂r : ZMod r → ZMod r → ZMod r :=
      fun n d => n + ((e B).1 + (e L).1) * d + (e η₂).1
    let F₁s : ZMod s → ZMod s → ZMod s :=
      fun n d => n + (e B).2 * d + (e η₁).2
    let F₂s : ZMod s → ZMod s → ZMod s :=
      fun n d => n + ((e B).2 + (e L).2) * d + (e η₂).2
    (∑ n : ZMod (r * s), ∑ d : ZMod (r * s),
      if IsUnit (F₁ n d * F₂ n d) then
        ZMod.stdAddChar (A * L * (F₁ n d * F₂ n d)⁻¹ + h * n + k * d)
      else 0) =
      (∑ n : ZMod r, ∑ d : ZMod r,
        if IsUnit (F₁r n d * F₂r n d) then
          ZMod.stdAddChar
            ((s : ZMod r)⁻¹ *
              ((e A).1 * (e L).1 * (F₁r n d * F₂r n d)⁻¹ +
                (e h).1 * n + (e k).1 * d))
        else 0) *
      (∑ n : ZMod s, ∑ d : ZMod s,
        if IsUnit (F₁s n d * F₂s n d) then
          ZMod.stdAddChar
            ((r : ZMod s)⁻¹ *
              ((e A).2 * (e L).2 * (F₁s n d * F₂s n d)⁻¹ +
                (e h).2 * n + (e k).2 * d))
        else 0)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_pole_masked_affine_phase_eq
statement:
theorem sum_pole_masked_affine_phase_eq
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (A B L η₁ η₂ h k : ZMod p)
    (hAL : A * L ≠ 0) :
    let F₁ : ZMod p → ZMod p → ZMod p := fun n d => n + B * d + η₁
    let F₂ : ZMod p → ZMod p → ZMod p := fun n d => n + (B + L) * d + η₂
    let b : ZMod p := (k - h * B) / L
    let a : ZMod p := h - b
    (∑ n : ZMod p, ∑ d : ZMod p,
      if IsUnit (F₁ n d * F₂ n d) then
        ZMod.stdAddChar (A * L / (F₁ n d * F₂ n d) + h * n + k * d)
      else 0) =
      ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * η₁ + b * η₂)) *
        ∑ u : (ZMod p)ˣ, ∑ v : (ZMod p)ˣ,
          ZMod.stdAddChar
            (A * L / ((u : ZMod p) * (v : ZMod p)) +
              a * (u : ZMod p) + b * (v : ZMod p))

name: PrimeGap186.sum_pos_multiples
statement:
theorem sum_pos_multiples {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    (T d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (f : ℕ → M) :
    (∑ k ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 T).filter (fun k => d ∣ k), f k) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (T / d), f (d * i)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_positiveFactorPairs_filter_fst_eq_sum_multipliers
statement:
theorem sum_positiveFactorPairs_filter_fst_eq_sum_multipliers
    {Q : ℕ} {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    (P : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (f : ℕ → ℕ → M) :
    (∑ p ∈ (positiveFactorPairs Q).filter (fun p ↦ P p.1),
      f p.1 p.2) =
      ∑ d ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 Q with P d,
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 (Q / d), f d k

name: PrimeGap186.sum_primeFactors_logFragment_eq_logSize
statement:
theorem sum_primeFactors_logFragment_eq_logSize (R : ℝ) (hR : 1 < R) {D : ℕ} (hD : Squarefree D) :
    ((D.primeFactors.sum (logFragment R) : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) = logSize R D

name: PrimeGap186.sum_primePowerError_le
statement:
theorem sum_primePowerError_le (S : Finset ℕ) (X : ℝ) (hX : 1 ≤ X)
    (hS : S ⊆ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊X⌋₊) :
    (∑ n ∈ S, primePowerError n) ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt X * Real.log X

name: PrimeGap186.sum_primeTuples_Icc
statement:
theorem sum_primeTuples_Icc {k : ℕ} (A B : ℕ) (g : (Fin k → ℕ) → ℝ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc A B,
      ∑ p ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin k => Nat.primesLE n),
        if (∏ i, p i) = n then g p else 0) =
    ∑ p ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin k => Nat.primesLE B),
      if (∏ i, p i) ∈ Finset.Icc A B then g p else 0

name: PrimeGap186.sum_primeTuples_closed_prefix
statement:
theorem sum_primeTuples_closed_prefix
    (n : ℕ) (s : Finset ℕ) (hs : ∀ q ∈ s, q.Prime)
    (A B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (cut : (Fin (n + 1) → ℕ) → Prop) :
    (∑ p ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => s),
      if (∏ i, p i) ∈ Finset.Icc (Nat.ceil A) (Nat.floor B) ∧ cut p
      then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
      ∑ p ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin n => s),
        let M : ℕ := ∏ i, p i
        ∑ q ∈ (Finset.Icc (Nat.ceil (A / (M : ℝ)))
            (Nat.floor (B / (M : ℝ)))).filter Nat.Prime,
          if q ∈ s ∧ cut (Fin.snoc p q) then (1 : ℝ) else 0

name: PrimeGap186.sum_prime_band_closed_division
statement:
theorem sum_prime_band_closed_division {β : Type*} [AddCommMonoid β]
    (s : Finset ℕ) (hs : ∀ q ∈ s, q.Prime)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (A B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (F : ℕ → β) :
    (∑ q ∈ s, if m * q ∈ Finset.Icc (Nat.ceil A) (Nat.floor B) then F q else 0) =
      ∑ q ∈ (Finset.Icc (Nat.ceil (A / (m : ℝ)))
          (Nat.floor (B / (m : ℝ)))).filter Nat.Prime,
        if q ∈ s then F q else 0

name: PrimeGap186.sum_prime_divisorsAntidiagonal
statement:
theorem sum_prime_divisorsAntidiagonal
    {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A] (n : ℕ) (P : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred P]
    (w : ℕ → ℕ → A) :
    (∑ d ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, if d.1.Prime ∧ P d.1 then w d.1 d.2 else 0) =
      ∑ p ∈ (Nat.primesLE n).filter (fun p => P p ∧ p ∣ n), w p (n / p)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_prime_divisors_eq_sum_bool
statement:
theorem sum_prime_divisors_eq_sum_bool {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A]
    (S : Finset ℕ) (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, Nat.Prime p) (f : ℕ → A) :
    (∑ r ∈ (∏ p ∈ S, p).divisors, f r) =
      ∑ b : S → Bool, f (∏ p : S, if b p then p.val else 1)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_prime_eq_prime_log_sum_partial_summation
statement:
theorem sum_prime_eq_prime_log_sum_partial_summation
    (a : ℕ → ℂ) (X : ℕ) (hX : 2 ≤ X) :
    (∑ p ∈ Finset.Icc 1 X with Nat.Prime p, a p) =
      (Real.log (X : ℝ))⁻¹ •
        (∑ p ∈ Finset.Icc 1 X with Nat.Prime p,
          a p * (Real.log (p : ℝ) : ℂ)) +
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 2 X,
        ((Real.log (k : ℝ))⁻¹ - (Real.log ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹) •
          (∑ p ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k with Nat.Prime p,
            a p * (Real.log (p : ℝ) : ℂ))

name: PrimeGap186.sum_prime_pair_divisorsAntidiagonal
statement:
theorem sum_prime_pair_divisorsAntidiagonal
    {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A] (n : ℕ) (P : ℕ → Prop) (Q : ℕ → ℕ → Prop)
    [DecidablePred P] [∀ p, DecidablePred (Q p)]
    (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → A) :
    (∑ d ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, ∑ e ∈ d.2.divisorsAntidiagonal,
      if (d.1.Prime ∧ P d.1) ∧ (e.1.Prime ∧ Q d.1 e.1) then w d.1 e.1 e.2 else 0) =
    ∑ p ∈ (Nat.primesLE n).filter (fun p => P p ∧ p ∣ n),
      ∑ q ∈ (Nat.primesLE (n / p)).filter (fun q => Q p q ∧ q ∣ n / p),
        w p q ((n / p) / q)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_prime_powers_log_le_log
statement:
theorem sum_prime_powers_log_le_log
    {x p : ℕ} (hx : 2 ≤ x) (hp : Nat.Prime p) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 x with p ^ k ≤ x,
      Real.log (p : ℝ)) ≤ Real.log (x : ℝ)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_primitiveCenteredEndpointMaximum_eq_raw
statement:

name: PrimeGap186.sum_primitiveRawEndpointMaximum_nonneg

name: PrimeGap186.sum_primitive_conductors_up_to_eq_sum_positiveFactorPairs
statement:
theorem sum_primitive_conductors_up_to_eq_sum_positiveFactorPairs
    {Q : ℕ} {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    (F : ∀ {q d : ℕ}, d ∣ q → primitiveCharacters d → M) :
    (∑ q ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 Q,
      ∑ d : q.divisors,
        ∑ ψ : primitiveCharacters d.1,
          F (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors d.2) ψ) =
      ∑ p ∈ positiveFactorPairs Q,
        ∑ ψ : primitiveCharacters p.1,
          F (Nat.dvd_mul_right p.1 p.2) ψ

name: PrimeGap186.sum_radical_div_sqrt_le_of_radical_dvd
statement:
theorem sum_radical_div_sqrt_le_of_radical_dvd
    (b : ℕ) (hb : b ≠ 0) (S : Finset ℕ)
    (hS : ∀ n ∈ S, 0 < n ∧ radical n ∣ b) :
    (∑ n ∈ S, ((radical n : ℕ) : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)) ≤
      Real.sqrt (b : ℝ) * (b.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ 3

name: PrimeGap186.sum_range_eq_sum_zmod
statement:
theorem sum_range_eq_sum_zmod (q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (f : ZMod q → ℝ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range q, f (n : ZMod q)) = ∑ n : ZMod q, f n

name: PrimeGap186.sum_range_erase_eq_sum_displacements
statement:
theorem sum_range_erase_eq_sum_displacements {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (K : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℕ → M) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, ∑ l ∈ (Finset.range K).erase k, c k l) =
      ∑ h ∈ Finset.Ico 1 K, ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (K - h), (c (l + h) l + c l (l + h))

name: PrimeGap186.sum_range_inv_nat_add_one_eq_harmonic
statement:
theorem sum_range_inv_nat_add_one_eq_harmonic (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹) =
      (harmonic N : ℝ)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_range_moebiusSquare
statement:
theorem sum_range_moebiusSquare (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), moebiusSquare n) =
      moebiusSquarePrefix N

name: PrimeGap186.sum_range_norm_sub_le_of_lipschitzOnWith_of_eq_zero_outside
statement:
theorem sum_range_norm_sub_le_of_lipschitzOnWith_of_eq_zero_outside
    {E : Type*} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E]
    (f : ℝ → E) (K : ℝ≥0) (a b : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : LipschitzOnWith K f (Set.Icc a b))
    (hf0 : ∀ x ∉ Set.Ioo a b, f x = 0)
    (t : ℕ → ℝ) (ht : Monotone t) (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, ‖f (t (i + 1)) - f (t i)‖ ≤
      (K : ℝ) * (b - a)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_real_Icc_divisorsAntidiagonal_fixed
statement:
theorem sum_real_Icc_divisorsAntidiagonal_fixed (A B : ℝ) (p : ℕ)
    (hA : 0 < A) (hAB : A ≤ B) (hp : 0 < p) (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc ⌈A⌉₊ ⌊B⌋₊, ∑ d ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal,
      if d.1 = p then f d.2 else 0) =
      ∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc ⌈A / (p : ℝ)⌉₊ ⌊B / (p : ℝ)⌋₊, f q

name: PrimeGap186.sum_reciprocalSine_Ico_le_half_mul_harmonic
statement:
theorem sum_reciprocalSine_Ico_le_half_mul_harmonic
    {q m : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (hmq : 2 * m ≤ q) :
    (∑ a ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (m + 1), reciprocalSineTerm q a) ≤
      (q : ℝ) / 2 * (harmonic m : ℝ)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_reciprocalSine_Ico_lt_mul_log
statement:
theorem sum_reciprocalSine_Ico_lt_mul_log {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q) :
    (∑ a ∈ Finset.Ico 1 q,
      (Real.sin (Real.pi * (a : ℝ) / (q : ℝ)))⁻¹) <
      (q : ℝ) * Real.log (q : ℝ)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_reciprocalSine_even_eq_two_mul_add_one
statement:
theorem sum_reciprocalSine_even_eq_two_mul_add_one
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    (∑ a ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (2 * m), reciprocalSineTerm (2 * m) a) =
      2 * (∑ a ∈ Finset.Ico 1 m, reciprocalSineTerm (2 * m) a) + 1

name: PrimeGap186.sum_reciprocalSine_odd_eq_two_mul
statement:
theorem sum_reciprocalSine_odd_eq_two_mul (m : ℕ) :
    (∑ a ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (2 * m + 1), reciprocalSineTerm (2 * m + 1) a) =
      2 * ∑ a ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (m + 1), reciprocalSineTerm (2 * m + 1) a

name: PrimeGap186.sum_reduced_indicator
statement:
theorem sum_reduced_indicator {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (n : ℕ) (v : ℂ) :
    (∑ b ∈ primitiveResidues q, if n % q = b % q then v else 0) =
      if Nat.Coprime n q then v else 0

name: PrimeGap186.sum_reduced_mixedProgressionMass
statement:
theorem sum_reduced_mixedProgressionMass (f : ℕ →₀ ℂ)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (r a : ℕ) :
    (∑ b ∈ primitiveResidues q, mixedProgressionMass f q r a b) =
      coprimeProgressionMass f q r a

name: PrimeGap186.sum_reverse_cosecant_eq_neg_incomingCosecantSum
statement:
theorem sum_reverse_cosecant_eq_neg_incomingCosecantSum (x : ι → ℝ) (u : ι → ℂ) (s : ι) :
    (∑ r ∈ Finset.univ.erase s,
      u r * (((Real.sin (Real.pi * (x s - x r)))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
      -incomingCosecantSum x u s

name: PrimeGap186.sum_shallowCandidateContribution_eq_mainZeroTerms_add_correction_of_isPrimitive
statement:
theorem
    sum_shallowCandidateContribution_eq_mainZeroTerms_add_correction_of_isPrimitive
    {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (chi : DirichletCharacter ℂ q)
    (hchi : chi.IsPrimitive) (x T : ℝ) (hx : 1 < x) :
    (∑ rho ∈
        dirichletExplicitFormulaShallowCandidateSingularitiesFinset chi x T,
      dirichletExplicitFormulaCandidateContribution chi x rho) =
      dirichletExplicitFormulaMainZeroTerms chi x T +
        dirichletExplicitFormulaShallowMainTermCorrection chi x

name: PrimeGap186.sum_shared_prime_weights_le
statement:
theorem sum_shared_prime_weights_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (S : Finset ℕ) (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, Nat.Prime p) :
    let Q := (∏ p ∈ S, p).divisors
    let T := Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : ι => Q)
    let M := (∑ s ∈ Q, (Nat.totient s : ℝ)⁻¹)
    (∑ r ∈ T, (∏ l, (Nat.totient (r l) : ℝ)⁻¹) *
      (∑ j, ∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun k : ι => j ≠ k), ∑ p ∈ S,
        (if p ∣ r j ∧ p ∣ r k then (1 : ℝ) else 0))) ≤
      (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) ^ 2 * M ^ (Fintype.card ι) * (∑ p ∈ S, 1 / (p : ℝ) ^ 2)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_sorted_prime_pairs_real_Icc
statement:
theorem sum_sorted_prime_pairs_real_Icc
    (A B z : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) (hAB : A ≤ B) :
    (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc (Nat.ceil A) (Nat.floor B),
      (((m.divisorsAntidiagonal.filter fun d : ℕ × ℕ =>
        d.1.Prime ∧ d.2.Prime ∧ d.1 ≤ d.2 ∧ z ≤ (d.1 : ℝ)).card : ℕ) : ℝ)) =
      ∑ q ∈ (Nat.primesLE (Nat.floor (Real.sqrt B))).filter
          (fun q : ℕ => z ≤ (q : ℝ)),
        (((Finset.Icc (max q (Nat.ceil (A / (q : ℝ))))
            (Nat.floor (B / (q : ℝ)))).filter Nat.Prime).card : ℝ)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_sq_divisor_filter_eq_pair_count
statement:
theorem sum_sq_divisor_filter_eq_pair_count (D I : Finset ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ I, (∑ d ∈ D.filter (fun d => d ∣ n), moebiusReal d) ^ 2) =
      ∑ d ∈ D, ∑ e ∈ D, moebiusReal d * moebiusReal e *
        (((I.filter (fun n => Nat.lcm d e ∣ n)).card : ℕ) : ℝ)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_sq_moebius_div_le_two_thirds
statement:
theorem sum_sq_moebius_div_le_two_thirds
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 N,
      (((ArithmeticFunction.moebius n : ℤ) : ℝ)) ^ 2 / (n : ℝ)) ≤
      (2 / 3 : ℝ) * (Real.log (N : ℝ) + 3)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_sq_moebius_eq_card_squarefree
statement:
theorem sum_sq_moebius_eq_card_squarefree (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 N,
      (((ArithmeticFunction.moebius n : ℤ) : ℝ)) ^ 2) =
      (((Finset.Ioc 0 N).filter Squarefree).card : ℝ)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_sq_moebius_le_two_thirds
statement:
theorem sum_sq_moebius_le_two_thirds (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 N,
      (((ArithmeticFunction.moebius n : ℤ) : ℝ)) ^ 2) ≤
      (2 / 3 : ℝ) * ((N : ℝ) + 2)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_sq_moebius_mul_card_divisors_div_le_four_ninths
statement:
theorem sum_sq_moebius_mul_card_divisors_div_le_four_ninths
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 N,
      (((ArithmeticFunction.moebius n : ℤ) : ℝ)) ^ 2 *
        (n.divisors.card : ℝ) / (n : ℝ)) ≤
      (4 / 9 : ℝ) * (Real.log (N : ℝ) + 3) ^ 2

name: PrimeGap186.sum_sq_moebius_pair_lcm_le
statement:
theorem sum_sq_moebius_pair_lcm_le
    {Z B : ℕ} (hZ : 1 ≤ Z) :
    (∑ d ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 Z,
      ∑ e ∈ (Finset.Ioc 0 Z).filter
        (fun e => Nat.lcm d e ≤ B),
        (((ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℤ) : ℝ)) ^ 2 *
          (((ArithmeticFunction.moebius e : ℤ) : ℝ)) ^ 2) ≤
      (B : ℝ) *
        ((2 / 3 : ℝ) * (Real.log (Z : ℝ) + 3)) ^ 2

name: PrimeGap186.sum_sq_vaughanFourthCoefficient_dyadic_le
statement:
theorem sum_sq_vaughanFourthCoefficient_dyadic_le
    {N V : ℝ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hV : 1 ≤ V) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊N⌋₊ ⌊2 * N⌋₊,
      (vaughanFourthCoefficient V n) ^ 2) ≤
      (4 / 3 : ℝ) * N * (Real.log V + 3) ^ 2

name: PrimeGap186.sum_sq_vaughanFourthCoefficient_prefix_le
statement:
theorem sum_sq_vaughanFourthCoefficient_prefix_le
    {V : ℝ} (hV : 1 ≤ V) (X : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 X,
      (vaughanFourthCoefficient V n) ^ 2) ≤
      (4 / 3 : ℝ) * (X : ℝ) * (Real.log V + 3) ^ 2

name: PrimeGap186.sum_squarefree_primePowerDiscrepancy_le
statement:
theorem sum_squarefree_primePowerDiscrepancy_le
    (J Q : ℕ) (hQ : 0 < Q) (S : Finset ℕ) (X : ℝ) (hX : 1 ≤ X)
    (hS : S ⊆ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊X⌋₊) (a : ℕ → ℕ) :
    (∑ q ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 Q).filter Squarefree,
      (q.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ J * |primePowerDiscrepancy S q (a q)|) ≤
      (3 * Real.sqrt X + (Q : ℝ) + 2 * (Q : ℝ) * X ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ)) *
        Real.log X * (1 + Real.log (Q : ℝ)) ^ (2 ^ (J + 1))

name: PrimeGap186.sum_star_mul_dft
statement:
theorem sum_star_mul_dft {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (f : ZMod q → ℂ) :
    (∑ k : ZMod q, star (ZMod.dft f k) * ZMod.dft f k) =
      (q : ℂ) * ∑ j : ZMod q, star (f j) * f j

name: PrimeGap186.sum_three_divisors_mul_prime
statement:
theorem sum_three_divisors_mul_prime
    {α : Type*} [AddCommMonoid α] (p m : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p)
    (hcop : Nat.Coprime p m) (F : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → α) :
    (∑ a ∈ (p * m).divisorsAntidiagonal,
      ∑ b ∈ a.2.divisorsAntidiagonal, F a.1 b.1 b.2) =
      ∑ a ∈ m.divisorsAntidiagonal, ∑ b ∈ a.2.divisorsAntidiagonal,
        (F (p * a.1) b.1 b.2 + F a.1 (p * b.1) b.2 + F a.1 b.1 (p * b.2))

name: PrimeGap186.sum_three_prime_divisorsAntidiagonal
statement:
theorem sum_three_prime_divisorsAntidiagonal {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A]
    (n : ℕ) (w : (Fin 3 → ℕ) → A) :
    (∑ a ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, ∑ b ∈ a.2.divisorsAntidiagonal,
      if a.1.Prime ∧ b.1.Prime ∧ b.2.Prime then w ![a.1, b.1, b.2] else 0) =
      ∑ p ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin 3 => Nat.primesLE n),
        if (∏ i, p i) = n then w p else 0

name: PrimeGap186.sum_torus_phase_eq_sum_rescaled
statement:
theorem sum_torus_phase_eq_sum_rescaled
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (a b c : ZMod p)
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    (∑ u : (ZMod p)ˣ, ∑ v : (ZMod p)ˣ,
      ZMod.stdAddChar
        (c / ((u : ZMod p) * (v : ZMod p)) +
          a * (u : ZMod p) + b * (v : ZMod p))) =
      ∑ U : (ZMod p)ˣ, ∑ V : (ZMod p)ˣ,
        ZMod.stdAddChar
          ((U : ZMod p) + (V : ZMod p) +
            a * b * c / ((U : ZMod p) * (V : ZMod p)))

name: PrimeGap186.sum_torus_phase_of_zero_frequency
statement:
theorem sum_torus_phase_of_zero_frequency
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (a b c : ZMod p) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hab : a = 0 ∨ b = 0) :
    (∑ u : (ZMod p)ˣ, ∑ v : (ZMod p)ˣ,
      ZMod.stdAddChar
        (c / ((u : ZMod p) * (v : ZMod p)) +
          a * (u : ZMod p) + b * (v : ZMod p))) =
      if a = 0 ∧ b = 0 then 1 - (p : ℂ) else 1

name: PrimeGap186.sum_trialCellMidpoint
statement:
theorem sum_trialCellMidpoint (j : Fin 40 → ℕ) :
    (∑ i : Fin 40, (trialCellMidpoint (j i) : ℝ)) =
      (((∑ i : Fin 40, j i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 20) * (trialMesh : ℝ)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_triple_list_divisorsAntidiagonal
statement:
theorem sum_triple_list_divisorsAntidiagonal
    {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A]
    (F : Finset (List ℕ))
    (hshape : ∀ ps ∈ F, ∃ p q r : ℕ, ps = [p, q, r])
    (w : List ℕ → ℕ → A) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ ps ∈ F, ∑ d ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal,
      if d.1 = ps.prod then w ps d.2 else 0) =
      ∑ a ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, ∑ b ∈ a.2.divisorsAntidiagonal,
        ∑ c ∈ b.2.divisorsAntidiagonal,
          if [a.1, b.1, c.1] ∈ F then w [a.1, b.1, c.1] c.2 else 0

name: PrimeGap186.sum_two_prime_divisorsAntidiagonal
statement:
theorem sum_two_prime_divisorsAntidiagonal {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A]
    (n : ℕ) (w : (Fin 2 → ℕ) → A) :
    (∑ d ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal,
      if d.1.Prime ∧ d.2.Prime then w ![d.1, d.2] else 0) =
      ∑ p ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin 2 => Nat.primesLE n),
        if (∏ i, p i) = n then w p else 0

name: PrimeGap186.sum_unitAddCircleAddChar_Ioc_eq_cosecant
statement:
theorem sum_unitAddCircleAddChar_Ioc_eq_cosecant
    (t : ℝ) (ht : (t : UnitAddCircle) ≠ 0) (m0 N : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc m0 (m0 + N),
      unitAddCircleAddChar (n • (t : UnitAddCircle))) =
      Complex.I / 2 *
        (Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I *
          (((m0 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * t)) -
         Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I *
          ((((m0 + N : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * t))) *
        (((Real.sin (Real.pi * t))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_units_char_div
statement:
theorem sum_units_char_div (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (a : ZMod p) :
    (∑ u : (ZMod p)ˣ, ZMod.stdAddChar (a / (u : ZMod p))) =
      if a = 0 then (p : ℂ) - 1 else -1

name: PrimeGap186.sum_units_crt
statement:
theorem sum_units_crt (m n : ℕ) [NeZero m] [NeZero n]
    (hmn : m.Coprime n) (f : ZMod m → ℂ) (g : ZMod n → ℂ) :
    (∑ h : (ZMod (m * n))ˣ,
      f ((h : ZMod (m * n)).val : ZMod m) *
        g ((h : ZMod (m * n)).val : ZMod n)) =
      (∑ h : (ZMod m)ˣ, f (h : ZMod m)) *
        (∑ h : (ZMod n)ˣ, g (h : ZMod n))

name: PrimeGap186.sum_units_crt_twist
statement:
theorem sum_units_crt_twist
    (m n : ℕ) [NeZero m] [NeZero n] (hmn : m.Coprime n)
    (f : ZMod m → ℂ) (g : ZMod n → ℂ) (k : ℤ) :
    (∑ h : (ZMod (m * n))ˣ,
      f ((h : ZMod (m * n)).val : ZMod m) *
        g ((h : ZMod (m * n)).val : ZMod n) *
          ZMod.stdAddChar ((k : ZMod (m * n)) * (h : ZMod (m * n)))) =
      (∑ h : (ZMod m)ˣ,
        f (h : ZMod m) *
          ZMod.stdAddChar (((k : ZMod m) * (n : ZMod m)⁻¹) * (h : ZMod m))) *
      (∑ h : (ZMod n)ˣ,
        g (h : ZMod n) *
          ZMod.stdAddChar (((k : ZMod n) * (m : ZMod n)⁻¹) * (h : ZMod n)))

name: PrimeGap186.sum_units_eq_primitiveResidues
statement:
theorem sum_units_eq_primitiveResidues {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (F : ℕ → ℂ) :
    (∑ u : (ZMod q)ˣ, F (u : ZMod q).val) =
      ∑ b ∈ primitiveResidues q, F b

name: PrimeGap186.sum_units_eq_sum_ite
statement:
theorem sum_units_eq_sum_ite (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (f : ZMod p → ℂ) :
    (∑ u : (ZMod p)ˣ, f (u : ZMod p)) =
      ∑ x : ZMod p, if x ≠ 0 then f x else 0

name: PrimeGap186.sum_units_eq_sum_reduced
statement:
theorem sum_units_eq_sum_reduced
    (Q : ℕ) (f : reducedFractionIndices Q → ℝ) :
    (∑ q : positiveModuliUpTo Q, ∑ u : (ZMod q.1)ˣ, f ⟨q, u⟩) =
      ∑ z : reducedFractionIndices Q, f z

name: PrimeGap186.sum_units_eq_sum_sub_zero
statement:
theorem sum_units_eq_sum_sub_zero (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (f : ZMod p → ℂ) :
    (∑ u : (ZMod p)ˣ, f (u : ZMod p)) = (∑ x : ZMod p, f x) - f 0

name: PrimeGap186.sum_units_invCharacter_mul_stdAddChar_eq_sum_zmod
statement:
theorem sum_units_invCharacter_mul_stdAddChar_eq_sum_zmod
    {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (n : ZMod q) :
    (∑ u : (ZMod q)ˣ,
      χ⁻¹ (u : ZMod q) * ZMod.stdAddChar ((u : ZMod q) * n)) =
      ∑ a : ZMod q, χ⁻¹ a * ZMod.stdAddChar (a * n)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_units_inv_cube_twist
statement:
theorem sum_units_inv_cube_twist
    (q r : ℕ) [NeZero q] (hrq : r.Coprime q) (f : ZMod q → ℂ) (k : ℤ) :
    (∑ h : (ZMod q)ˣ,
      f ((h : ZMod q) * ((r : ZMod q)⁻¹) ^ 3) *
        ZMod.stdAddChar (((k : ZMod q) * (r : ZMod q)⁻¹) * (h : ZMod q))) =
      ∑ h : (ZMod q)ˣ,
        f (h : ZMod q) *
          ZMod.stdAddChar (((k * (r : ℤ) ^ 2 : ℤ) : ZMod q) * (h : ZMod q))

name: PrimeGap186.sum_units_mul
statement:
theorem sum_units_mul (q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (f : ZMod q → ℂ)
    (a : ZMod q) (ha : IsUnit a) :
    (∑ h : (ZMod q)ˣ, f (a * (h : ZMod q))) =
      ∑ h : (ZMod q)ˣ, f (h : ZMod q)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_weightedInducingPrimitiveCenteredEndpointMaximum_eq_allFactorPairs
statement:
theorem sum_weightedInducingPrimitiveCenteredEndpointMaximum_eq_allFactorPairs
    (x Q : ℕ) :
    (∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 Q,
      (q.totient : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q,
          inducingPrimitiveCenteredEndpointMaximum x q χ) =
      ∑ p ∈ (positiveFactorPairs Q).filter (fun p ↦ p.1 ≠ 1),
        ((p.1 * p.2).totient : ℝ)⁻¹ *
          ∑ ψ : primitiveCharacters p.1,
            primitiveCenteredEndpointMaximum x p.1 ψ

name: PrimeGap186.sum_weightedPrimitiveVaughanFiveTermEndpointMajorant_eq
statement:
theorem sum_weightedPrimitiveVaughanFiveTermEndpointMajorant_eq
    (U V : ℝ) (x Q : ℕ) :
    (∑ q ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 Q,
      (q : ℝ) / (q.totient : ℝ) *
        ∑ chi : primitiveCharacters q,
          vaughanFiveTermEndpointMajorant U V x q chi.1) =
      (∑ q ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 Q,
        (q : ℝ) / (q.totient : ℝ) *
          ∑ chi : primitiveCharacters q,
            vaughanTwistedSumOneEndpointMaximum U x q chi.1) +
      (∑ q ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 Q,
        (q : ℝ) / (q.totient : ℝ) *
          ∑ chi : primitiveCharacters q,
            vaughanTwistedSumTwoEndpointMaximum V x q chi.1) +
      (∑ q ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 Q,
        (q : ℝ) / (q.totient : ℝ) *
          ∑ chi : primitiveCharacters q,
            vaughanTwistedSumThreeSmallEndpointMaximum U V x q chi.1) +
      (∑ q ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 Q,
        (q : ℝ) / (q.totient : ℝ) *
          ∑ chi : primitiveCharacters q,
            vaughanTwistedSumThreeLargeEndpointMaximum U V x q chi.1) +
      (∑ q ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 Q,
        (q : ℝ) / (q.totient : ℝ) *
          ∑ chi : primitiveCharacters q,
            vaughanTwistedSumFourEndpointMaximum U V x q chi.1)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_weightedPrimitiveVaughanTwistedSumFourEndpointMaximum_le_of_psi
statement:
theorem sum_weightedPrimitiveVaughanTwistedSumFourEndpointMaximum_le_of_psi
    {A U V : ℝ} {x Q : ℕ}
    (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hpsi : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 ≤ z → Chebyshev.psi z ≤ A * z)
    (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hU : 1 ≤ U) (hV : 1 ≤ V) :
    (∑ q ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 Q,
      (q : ℝ) / (q.totient : ℝ) *
        ∑ chi : primitiveCharacters q,
          vaughanTwistedSumFourEndpointMaximum U V x q chi.1) ≤
      vaughanFourthBlockConstant A / Real.log 2 *
        ((x : ℝ) + (Q : ℝ) * (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt V +
          Real.sqrt 2 * (Q : ℝ) * (x : ℝ) / Real.sqrt U +

name: PrimeGap186.sum_weighted_bilinearProductCutoffMaximum_le
statement:
theorem sum_weighted_bilinearProductCutoffMaximum_le
    {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K) (Q : ℕ)
    (sm sn : Finset ℕ) (a b : ℕ → ℂ) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T)
    (hmPos : ∀ m ∈ sm, 0 < m)
    (hnPos : ∀ n ∈ sn, 0 < n)
    (hprod : ∀ m ∈ sm, ∀ n ∈ sn, m * n ≤ K) :
    (∑ q ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 Q,
      (q : ℝ) / (q.totient : ℝ) *
        ∑ ψ : primitiveCharacters q,
          bilinearProductCutoffMaximum K q ψ.1 sm sn a b) ≤
      1 / Real.pi *
        (∫ t in -T..T,
          perronEnvelope (Real.log (2 * (K : ℝ))) t *
            ∑ q ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 Q,
              (q : ℝ) / (q.totient : ℝ) *
                ∑ ψ : primitiveCharacters q,
                  ‖∑ m ∈ sm, ∑ n ∈ sn,
                    (a m * natLogTwist m t) *
                      (b n * natLogTwist n t) * ψ.1 (m * n)‖) +
      2 * (K : ℝ) * (Q : ℝ) ^ 2 /
          (Real.pi * Real.log (4 / 3 : ℝ) * T) *
        (∑ m ∈ sm, ‖a m‖) * (∑ n ∈ sn, ‖b n‖)

      1 / Real.pi *
        (∫ t in -T..T,
          perronEnvelope
              (Real.log (2 * (((m0 + M) * (n0 + N) : ℕ) : ℝ))) t *
            ∑ q ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 Q,
              (q : ℝ) / (q.totient : ℝ) *
                ∑ ψ : primitiveCharacters q,
                  ‖∑ m ∈ sm, ∑ n ∈ sn,
                    (a m * natLogTwist m t) *
                      (b n * natLogTwist n t) * ψ.1 (m * n)‖) +
      2 * (((m0 + M) * (n0 + N) : ℕ) : ℝ) * (Q : ℝ) ^ 2 /

name: PrimeGap186.sum_weighted_bilinearProductCutoffMaximum_subset_Ioc_le_akbaryHambrookBilinearConstant
statement:

    (Q m0 M n0 N : ℕ) (hM : 0 < M) (hN : 0 < N)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_weighted_bilinearProductCutoffMaximum_subset_Ioc_le_preoptimized
statement:
theorem sum_weighted_bilinearProductCutoffMaximum_subset_Ioc_le_preoptimized
    (Q m0 M n0 N : ℕ) (hM : 0 < M) (hN : 0 < N)

name: PrimeGap186.sum_weighted_embedding
statement:
theorem sum_weighted_embedding
    {R α β γ : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
    [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype γ]

    (∑ j : α → γ, (∏ i : α, W (j i)) * ∏ b : β, V b (j (e b))) =
      (∑ x : γ, W x) ^ (Fintype.card α - Fintype.card β) *
        ∏ b : β, ∑ x : γ, W x * V b x

name: PrimeGap186.sum_weighted_prime_interval_discrepancy_le_of_log_prefix

    (hprefix : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ N →
      (∑ q ∈ Q, (q.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ J *
        ‖fullDiscrepancy
          (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico L (L + k),
            Finsupp.single n
              (if n.Prime then (Real.log (n : ℝ) : ℂ) else 0)) q (a q)‖) ≤ B) :
    (∑ q ∈ Q, (q.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ J *
      ‖fullDiscrepancy
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico L (L + N),

name: PrimeGap186.sum_weighted_vaughanFourthDyadicBlockMaximum_le_of_psi
statement:
theorem sum_weighted_vaughanFourthDyadicBlockMaximum_le_of_psi
    {A U V : ℝ} {x Q alpha : ℕ}
    (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hpsi : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 ≤ z → Chebyshev.psi z ≤ A * z)
    (_hx : 1 ≤ x) (_hU : 1 ≤ U) (hV : 1 ≤ V)
    (halpha : alpha ∈ vaughanFourthDyadicExponents U V x) :
    (∑ q ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 Q,
      (q : ℝ) / (q.totient : ℝ) *
        ∑ chi : primitiveCharacters q,
          vaughanFourthDyadicBlockMaximum U V x q alpha chi) ≤
      vaughanFourthBlockConstant A *
        ((x : ℝ) +
          (Q : ℝ) * Real.sqrt ((x : ℝ) * (2 ^ alpha : ℕ)) +
          (Q : ℝ) * (x : ℝ) /
            Real.sqrt ((2 ^ alpha : ℕ) : ℝ) +
          (Q : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (x : ℝ)) *
        Real.sqrt (Real.log (2 * ((2 ^ alpha : ℕ) : ℝ))) *
        Real.log (Real.exp 3 * V) * Real.log (4 * (x : ℝ))

name: PrimeGap186.sum_weighted_vaughanThirdLargeDyadicBlockMaximum_le

      (q : ℝ) / (q.totient : ℝ) *

      akbaryHambrookBilinearConstant *
        ((x : ℝ) +
          (Q : ℝ) * Real.sqrt ((x : ℝ) * (2 ^ alpha : ℕ)) +
          (Q : ℝ) * (x : ℝ) /
            Real.sqrt ((2 ^ alpha : ℕ) : ℝ) +

      (Nat.primesBelow (Nat.ceil (x ^ ((40481 : ℝ) / 100000)))).filter

    let B : ℝ :=
      ∑ p ∈ P, ∑ q ∈ (Nat.primesLE (Nat.floor (Real.sqrt (x / (p : ℝ))))).filter
          (fun q : ℕ => x ^ ((9519 : ℝ) / 50000) ≤ (q : ℝ)),

            (Nat.floor (v * x / ((p : ℝ) * (q : ℝ))))).filter Nat.Prime).card : ℝ)
    let E : ℝ :=
      ∑ p ∈ P, ∑ q ∈ (Nat.primesLE (Nat.floor (Real.sqrt (2 * (x / (p : ℝ)))))).filter
          (fun q : ℕ => x ^ ((9519 : ℝ) / 50000) ≤ (q : ℝ) ∧
            Real.sqrt (x / (p : ℝ)) < (q : ℝ)),
        (Nat.primeCounting (Nat.floor (2 * (x / (p : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ))) : ℝ)
    let S : ℝ :=
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (Nat.ceil (u * x)) (Nat.floor (v * x)),
        if ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n = 3 then
          siftedTheta x (1 : Fin 6) (fun _ => 1) n else 0

    let Q (p : ℕ) := (Nat.primesLE (Nat.floor (Real.sqrt (x / (p : ℝ))))).filter

    let R := (Nat.primesLE (Nat.floor (x ^ ((40481 : ℝ) / 100000)))).filter
      (fun p : ℕ => x ^ ((9519 : ℝ) / 50000) ≤ (p : ℝ))
    (∑ p ∈ R, (p : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤ H →
    (∀ p ∈ P, ∀ q ∈ Q p,
      |Real.log x / x *

            (1 - Real.logb x (p : ℝ) - Real.logb x (q : ℝ)))⁻¹)| ≤

name: PrimeGap186.theta6_a0_good_part_prime_windows
statement:
theorem theta6_a0_good_part_prime_windows
    (N Y r0 : ℕ) (z H S M0 lo hi : ℝ) (hH : 0 < H) (hS : 0 < S) :
    let A0 : ℕ → ℤ := fun n =>
      if 1 < z ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ M0 then
        ∑ p2 ∈ n.primeFactors, ∑ p3 ∈ n.primeFactors, ∑ p4 ∈ n.primeFactors,
          if p2 * p3 * p4 ∣ n ∧ z ≤ (p3 : ℝ) ∧ p3 < p2 ∧ (p2 : ℝ) < H ∧
              p3 ≤ p4 ∧ ((p3 * p4 : ℕ) : ℝ) < H ∧ (p2 : ℝ) < S ∧
              n / (p2 * p3 * p4) ∈ Nat.smoothNumbers (Nat.ceil z)
          then ArithmeticFunction.moebius (n / (p2 * p3 * p4)) else 0
      else 0
    let C1 : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℤ := fun m u v =>
      if 1 < z ∧ u * v ∣ m ∧ z ≤ (u : ℝ) ∧ u ≤ v ∧
          ((u * v : ℕ) : ℝ) < H ∧ m / (u * v) ∈ Nat.smoothNumbers (Nat.ceil z)
      then ArithmeticFunction.moebius (m / (u * v)) else 0
    let C2 : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℤ := fun m u v =>
      if 1 < z ∧ u * v ∣ m ∧ z ≤ (v : ℝ) ∧ v < u ∧
          (u : ℝ) < H ∧ (u : ℝ) < S ∧
          m / (u * v) ∈ Nat.smoothNumbers (Nat.ceil z)
      then ArithmeticFunction.moebius (m / (u * v)) else 0
    let W1 : ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ := fun m u =>
      Finset.Icc
        (max (Y + 1)
          (max (m.primeFactors.sup id + 1) (max (Nat.ceil (lo / (m : ℝ))) (u + 1))))
        (min (N / m) (min (Nat.floor (min hi M0 / (m : ℝ)))
          (min (Nat.ceil H - 1) (Nat.ceil S - 1))))
    let W2 : ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ := fun m v =>
      Finset.Icc
        (max (Y + 1)
          (max (m.primeFactors.sup id + 1) (max (Nat.ceil (lo / (m : ℝ))) v)))
        (min (N / m) (min (Nat.floor (min hi M0 / (m : ℝ)))
          (Nat.ceil (H / (v : ℝ)) - 1)))
    (∑ n ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 N).filter (fun n =>
        n ∉ Nat.factoredNumbers (Nat.primesLE Y) ∧
          ¬ ∃ r : ℕ, Nat.Prime r ∧ Y < r ∧ r ^ 2 ∣ n),
      Finsupp.single n (if lo ≤ (n : ℝ) ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ hi ∧ Nat.Coprime n r0
        then (A0 n : ℂ) else 0)) =
    ∑ m ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 N).filter (fun m =>
        ¬ ∃ r : ℕ, Nat.Prime r ∧ Y < r ∧ r ^ 2 ∣ m),
      ∑ u ∈ m.primeFactors, ∑ v ∈ m.primeFactors,
        ((∑ p ∈ (W1 m u).filter Nat.Prime,
          Finsupp.single (m * p)
            (if Nat.Coprime (m * p) r0 then (C1 m u v : ℂ) else 0)) +
        (∑ p ∈ (W2 m v).filter Nat.Prime,
          Finsupp.single (m * p)
            (if Nat.Coprime (m * p) r0 then (C2 m u v : ℂ) else 0)))

      ∀ (S : Finset ℕ), S ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊x ^ θ⌋₊ →

name: PrimeGap186.typeIIICompleteFiberSum_coprime_crt
statement:
theorem typeIIICompleteFiberSum_coprime_crt
    (m n : ℕ) [NeZero m] [NeZero n] (hmn : m.Coprime n)
    (h₁ h₂ h₃ : ZMod (m * n)) (a : (ZMod (m * n))ˣ) :
    let e := ZMod.chineseRemainder hmn
    let aₘ : (ZMod m)ˣ :=
      Units.map (((RingHom.fst (ZMod m) (ZMod n)).comp e.toRingHom).toMonoidHom) a
    let aₙ : (ZMod n)ˣ :=
      Units.map (((RingHom.snd (ZMod m) (ZMod n)).comp e.toRingHom).toMonoidHom) a
    typeIIICompleteFiberSum (m * n) h₁ h₂ h₃ a =
      typeIIICompleteFiberSum m ((n : ZMod m)⁻¹ * (e h₁).1)
        ((n : ZMod m)⁻¹ * (e h₂).1) ((n : ZMod m)⁻¹ * (e h₃).1) aₘ *
      typeIIICompleteFiberSum n ((m : ZMod n)⁻¹ * (e h₁).2)
        ((m : ZMod n)⁻¹ * (e h₂).2) ((m : ZMod n)⁻¹ * (e h₃).2) aₙ

name: PrimeGap186.typeIIICompleteFiberSum_good_bad_factorization
statement:
theorem typeIIICompleteFiberSum_good_bad_factorization
    (b d : ℕ) [NeZero b] [NeZero d] (hbd : Squarefree (b * d))
    (h₁ h₂ h₃ : ℤ)
    (hb : b = Int.gcd (h₁ * h₂ * h₃) ((b * d : ℕ) : ℤ))
    (a : (ZMod (b * d))ˣ) :
    let a_d : (ZMod d)ˣ :=
      Units.map ((ZMod.castHom (Nat.dvd_mul_left d b) (ZMod d)).toMonoidHom) a
    let c : ZMod d := (a_d : ZMod d) * (h₁ : ZMod d) * (h₂ : ZMod d) *
      (h₃ : ZMod d) * ((b : ZMod d)⁻¹) ^ 3
    typeIIICompleteFiberSum (b * d)
        (h₁ : ZMod (b * d)) (h₂ : ZMod (b * d)) (h₃ : ZMod (b * d)) a =
      typeIIICompleteFiberSum b (h₁ : ZMod b) (h₂ : ZMod b) (h₃ : ZMod b) 1 *
        normalizedKloosterman3Mod d c ∧
      IsUnit c ∧
      ‖typeIIICompleteFiberSum b (h₁ : ZMod b) (h₂ : ZMod b) (h₃ : ZMod b) 1‖ ≤
        ((Int.gcd h₁ ((b * d : ℕ) : ℤ) : ℝ) *
          (Int.gcd h₂ ((b * d : ℕ) : ℤ) : ℝ) *
          (Int.gcd h₃ ((b * d : ℕ) : ℤ) : ℝ)) / (b : ℝ) ^ 2

name: PrimeGap186.typeIII_balancing_source_ranges_eventually
statement:
theorem typeIII_balancing_source_ranges_eventually
    (qExp δ ε C : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hC : 1 ≤ C)
    (hgap : 3 * qExp + 3 * ε < 2 + δ) :
    ∃ X : ℝ, 1 ≤ X ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, X ≤ x →
        C * x ^ (-ε) ≤ (1 : ℝ) / 3 ∧
        ∀ M N Qcenter b B : ℝ,
          0 < M → 0 < N → 0 < Qcenter → 1 ≤ b → b ≤ B → b ≤ 2 * Qcenter →
          x / C ≤ M * N → Qcenter ≤ C * x ^ qExp →
            let Y : ℝ := x ^ δ
            let H : ℝ := Qcenter ^ 3 / N
            let Hb : ℝ := x ^ (3 * ε / 2) * H / B
            let Qlo : ℝ := Qcenter * (1 - C * x ^ (-ε))
            0 < Qlo ∧ Qcenter / 2 ≤ Qlo ∧ Qlo ≤ Qcenter ∧
              (∀ q : ℝ,
                Qcenter * (1 - C * x ^ (-ε)) ≤ q →
                q ≤ Qcenter * (1 + C * x ^ (-ε)) →
                  Qlo ≤ q ∧ q ≤ 2 * Qlo) ∧
              0 < Hb ∧ 1 ≤ Y ∧ 2 ≤ Y * Qcenter ∧
              Hb ^ 2 ≤ (Qcenter / b) ^ 4 * (b * Y) * M ^ 2

name: PrimeGap186.typeIII_coherent_good_modulus_coefficient
statement:
theorem typeIII_coherent_good_modulus_coefficient
    (b : ℕ+) (b₁ b₂ b₃ : ℕ)
    (hb₁ : 0 < b₁) (hb₂ : 0 < b₂) (hb₃ : 0 < b₃)
    (hb : (b : ℕ) = (radical (b₁ * b₂ * b₃) : ℕ))
    (D : Finset ℕ+)
    (hD : ∀ d ∈ D, Squarefree ((b : ℕ) * (d : ℕ)))
    (a₀ : ℤ) (a : ∀ d : ℕ+, (ZMod ((b : ℕ) * (d : ℕ)))ˣ)
    (ha : ∀ d ∈ D,
      (a d : ZMod ((b : ℕ) * (d : ℕ))) = (a₀ : ZMod ((b : ℕ) * (d : ℕ)))) :
    let P : ℕ := ∏ d ∈ D, (d : ℕ)
    let c : ZMod P := (a₀ : ZMod P) * ((b₁ * b₂ * b₃ : ℕ) : ZMod P) *
      (((b : ℕ) : ZMod P)⁻¹) ^ 3
    let A : ℤ := (c.val : ℤ)
    0 < P ∧ (D = ∅ → P = 1) ∧ Nat.Coprime (b : ℕ) P ∧ IsUnit c ∧
      (∀ q : ℕ, q ∣ P → IsUnit (A : ZMod q)) ∧
      ∀ d ∈ D, (d : ℕ) ∣ P ∧
        (A : ZMod (d : ℕ)) =
          ((Units.map ((ZMod.castHom (Nat.dvd_mul_left (d : ℕ) (b : ℕ))
            (ZMod (d : ℕ))).toMonoidHom) (a d) : (ZMod (d : ℕ))ˣ) : ZMod (d : ℕ)) *
            ((b₁ * b₂ * b₃ : ℕ) : ZMod (d : ℕ)) *
            (((b : ℕ) : ZMod (d : ℕ))⁻¹) ^ 3

name: PrimeGap186.typeIII_comparable_lcm_kernel_bound
statement:
theorem typeIII_comparable_lcm_kernel_bound
    (R : ℕ) (hR : 0 < R) (M H Q b : ℝ)
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hH : 0 ≤ H) (hQ : 0 < Q) (hb : 0 < b) :
    let I := Finset.Ico R (4 * R)
    let τR := I.sup (fun r : ℕ => r.divisors.card)
    (∑ r₁ ∈ I, ∑ r₂ ∈ I,
      ((M ^ 2 + M * Real.sqrt (Nat.gcd r₁ r₂ : ℝ)) / (r₁ : ℝ) ^ 2) *
        (H * Real.sqrt (b * (r₁ : ℝ)) /
            Real.sqrt (Q * (Nat.lcm r₁ r₂ : ℝ)) +
          Real.sqrt (Q * (Nat.lcm r₁ r₂ : ℝ)) /
            Real.sqrt (b * (r₁ : ℝ)))) ≤
      (M ^ 2 + M) *
        (12 * (τR : ℝ) * H * Real.sqrt b /
            (Real.sqrt Q * Real.sqrt (R : ℝ)) +
          18 * Real.sqrt Q * Real.sqrt (R : ℝ) / Real.sqrt b)

name: PrimeGap186.typeIII_comparable_lcm_kernel_sourceRange_bound
statement:
theorem typeIII_comparable_lcm_kernel_sourceRange_bound
    (R : Finset ℕ) (Rlo Rhi : ℝ) (hRlo : 0 < Rlo) (hRhi : 0 ≤ Rhi)
    (hR : ∀ r ∈ R, Rlo ≤ (r : ℝ) ∧ (r : ℝ) ≤ Rhi)
    (M H Q b : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hH : 0 ≤ H)
    (hQ : 0 < Q) (hb : 0 < b) :
    let J := R.image (fun r : ℕ => Nat.log 2 r)
    let τR := J.sup (fun j : ℕ =>
      (Finset.Ico ((2 : ℕ) ^ j) (4 * (2 : ℕ) ^ j)).sup
        (fun r : ℕ => r.divisors.card))
    (∑ r₁ ∈ R, ∑ r₂ ∈ R,
      if r₁ ≤ 2 * r₂ ∧ r₂ ≤ 2 * r₁ then
        ((M ^ 2 + M * Real.sqrt (Nat.gcd r₁ r₂ : ℝ)) / (r₁ : ℝ) ^ 2) *
          (H * Real.sqrt (b * (r₁ : ℝ)) /
              Real.sqrt (Q * (Nat.lcm r₁ r₂ : ℝ)) +
            Real.sqrt (Q * (Nat.lcm r₁ r₂ : ℝ)) /
              Real.sqrt (b * (r₁ : ℝ)))
      else 0) ≤
      (M ^ 2 + M) *
        (96 * (τR : ℝ) * H * Real.sqrt b /
            (Real.sqrt Q * Real.sqrt Rlo) +
          72 * Real.sqrt Q * Real.sqrt Rhi / Real.sqrt b)

name: PrimeGap186.typeIII_dense_factor_selection
statement:
theorem typeIII_dense_factor_selection
    (b : ℕ+) (Y : Set.Ici (1 : ℝ)) (D : Finset ℕ+)
    (Qlo Qhi S : ℝ) (hQlo : 0 < Qlo) (hQhi : Qlo ≤ Qhi)
    (hS : 1 ≤ S) (hSrange : S ≤ (Y : ℝ) * Qlo)
    (hD : ∀ d ∈ D,
      Squarefree ((b : ℕ) * (d : ℕ)) ∧
      Nonempty (DenseDivisibilityWitness
        Y 1 ((b : ℕ) * (d : ℕ))) ∧
      Qlo ≤ (b : ℝ) * (d : ℝ) ∧ (b : ℝ) * (d : ℝ) ≤ Qhi) :
    ∃ ρ σ : ℕ+ → ℕ+, ∀ d ∈ D,
      d = ρ d * σ d ∧
      Squarefree (ρ d : ℕ) ∧ Squarefree (σ d : ℕ) ∧
      Nat.Coprime (ρ d : ℕ) (σ d : ℕ) ∧
      Nat.Coprime (b : ℕ) ((ρ d : ℕ) * (σ d : ℕ)) ∧
      S / ((b : ℝ) * (Y : ℝ)) ≤ (σ d : ℝ) ∧ (σ d : ℝ) ≤ S ∧

name: PrimeGap186.typeIII_fineband_scale_bounds
statement:
